Translation of article ,which appeared in the "KOPEIKA"
of September 27,1934.

ISRAILEVITCH-BEAUMONT FAILED TO APPEAR IN COURT.
He preferred to withdraw his charge against V.A.Chilikin,
Editor of the "Kopeika".

An end was put at the Second Shanghai Special District
Court yesterday to the libel suit,which had been brought
against V.A.Chilikin,the Editor of this journal,by Israile-
vitch-Beaumont,Editor of the"Spectator" and recent candidate
for a seat on the Shanghai Municipal Council.

An article published in the "Kopeika",in which Israel-
levitch-Beaumont's chances of being elected had been discus-
sed,was chosen as material for accusation. In this article
certain facts relating to the past and present life of Isra-
ilevitch-Beaumont were mentioned,which he considered untrue
and insulting.

He brought a libel suit against V.A.Chilikin. During the
course of the second sitting of the court,Chilikin's legal
adviser,Mr K.V.Chang,asked the court to take steps in order
to obtain from the French Consulate-General materials regard-
ing a certain"conflict" of Israilevitch-Beaumont with the
French law,which had taken place in Paris some time ago in
connection with an affair involving a jewellery store in that
city.

As a result, the parties concerned were summoned to
attend the court yesterday morning.

Mr.V.A.Chilikin arrived at 9 a.m. together with his
legal adviser,Mr K.V.Chang. However,neither Israilevitch-
Beaumont nor his legal advisers were present.

The court informed V.A.Chilikin that Israilevitch-Beau-
mont had withdrawn his charge against him. This put an end
to the whole affair.

Thus,Israilevitch-Beaumont himself has proved the ve-
racity of "Kopeika's" information,the correctness of our con-
clusions and the impossibility of disproving our statements.

He was able to institute a libel suit and to make cer-
tain statements in the court,but when time had arrived for
him to face some irrefutable data,he preferred to do what
he ought to have done at the very outset: he recognised that
"Kopeika's" statement regarding him could not be disproved
and ,consequently, withdrew the charge.

This sad outcome will,probably,serve as a lesson for
other people who,being not immaculate themselves and even
having long records of excellent conflicts with morals-if
not with justice- are fond of bringing libel suits against
the press.

ISRAILEVITCH-BEAUMONT TERRORISED THE WHOLE SHANGHAI
BY HIS ARROGANCE AND ON THE PAGES OF HIS"SPECTATOR" SLUNG
MUD WITH IMPUNITY AT ANY ONE,WHOM HE CHOSE AS A TARGET.

HOWEVER,WHEN CORNERED, HE PROVED TO BE A COWARD
AND PUT HIS OWN SIGNATURE UNDER ALL STATEMENTS OF THE "KO-
PEIKA" REGARDING HIM.

日期 34年9月27日

译自1934年9月27日《戈佩伊卡报》（KOPEIKA）刊登的文章。

伊斯莱列维奇-博蒙特未出庭。
他宁愿撤回对《戈佩伊卡报》编辑 V.A. Chilikin 的指控。

昨日，上海第二特区地方法院终结了这起诽谤诉讼案。该案由《观察家报》编辑、近期上海工部局董事候选人伊斯莱列维奇-博蒙特（Israilevitch-Beaumont）针对该刊编辑 V.A. Chilikin 提起。

被选作指控依据的是《戈佩伊卡报》上发表的一篇文章，文中讨论了伊斯莱列维奇-博蒙特的当选几率。文章中提及了有关伊斯莱列维奇-博蒙特过去及现在生活的一些事实，他认为这些内容不实且带有侮辱性。

他对 V.A. Chilikin 提起了诽谤诉讼。在法庭第二次开庭审理期间，Chilikin 的法律顾问 K.V. Chang 先生请求法庭采取措施，以便从法国总领事馆获取关于伊斯莱列维奇-博蒙特此前在巴黎涉及当地一家珠宝店事务时与法国法律发生某种“冲突”的材料。

因此，有关各方被传唤于昨日上午出庭。

V.A. Chilikin 先生与其法律顾问 K.V. Chang 先生于上午9时到庭。然而，伊斯莱列维奇-博蒙特及其法律顾问均未出席。

法庭告知 V.A. Chilikin，伊斯莱列维奇-博蒙特已撤回对他的指控。至此，整个事件宣告结束。

因此，伊斯莱列维奇-博蒙特本人证实了《戈佩伊卡报》信息的真实性、我们结论的正确性以及我们要点无法被驳倒的事实。

他本可以提起诽谤诉讼并在法庭上发表某些声明，但当需要面对一些无可辩驳的数据时，他选择了他在最初就该做的事情：他承认《戈佩伊卡报》关于他的陈述无法被驳倒，因而撤回了指控。

这一令人遗憾的结果，或许能给那些自身并不清白、甚至有着长期违背道德（即便不是违背法律）良好记录的人上一课，这些人喜欢对新闻界提起诽谤诉讼。

伊斯莱列维奇-博蒙特以其傲慢恐吓了整个上海，并在其《观察家报》的版面上肆无忌惮地对他选定的任何目标进行抹黑。

然而，当陷入困境时，他却证明了自己是个懦夫，并在《戈佩伊卡报》关于他的所有陈述下签上了自己的名字（意指默认）。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, FRIDAY, MARCH 30, 1934

A.W. BEAUMONT GIVES
ANOTHER NAME

Admits To Court That He
Was Formerly Known
As "Israelovitch"

LABEL SUIT AGAINST
RUSSIAN EDITOR

"Beaumont appears on my
papers," declared Mr. A. W. Beau-
mont, editor of the "Shanghai
Spectator" and defeated candidate
at the recent municipal elections,
when questioned by Judge Wo at
the Second District Court yester-
day.

Beaumont, who is bringing an
action against V. A. Chilikin, edi-
tor of the "Kopeika," a Russian
daily newspaper, for alleged libel
in an article published in the
"Kopeika" on February 8, had pre-
viously admitted to the court that
he had formerly been known by
the name of Israelovitch.

Following Beaumont's declara-
tion that the name Beaumont ap-
peared on his papers, Mr. K. W.
Chang, for Chilikin, asked the
court that Beaumont be request-
ed to produce his papers.

At the opening of the hearing,
Mr. E. Y. S. Chiang, appearing
for the plaintiff, said that Beau-
mont based his suit on two par-
agraphs, alleging that there was
information available that during
his stay in Europe Beaumont had
been in some sort of conflict with
the law, and that since the be-
ginning of 1932 Beaumont had
been visiting gambling houses in
company with a well-known gam-
bler.

Conflict With The Law

For the defence, it was pointed
out that a conflict with the law
does not necessarily mean that a
person has committed a crime,
and that, secondly, the reference
to Beaumont's alleged visits to
gambling houses was not intended
as libel.

Requested by the Judge to sup-
ply sources of his information,
Chilikin gave an evasive reply and
asked the Judge to excuse him
from giving details. He stated that
he had received the information
from a reliable source, but refused
to disclose the name. He further
stated that he had been in Europe
in 1927 when Beaumont was known
as Israelovitch, and was connect-
ed with Beaumont in a business
transaction.

Chilikin said that the Shanghai
Consulate had details of the
affair in Europe. He also stated
that he had been informed by a
reliable source that Beaumont had
been connected with gambling
houses in Shanghai.

The Judge then adjourned the
case.

A.W. BEAUMONT 供出另一姓名
在法庭承认他曾名为“Israelovitch”

起诉俄国编辑的标签诉讼案

“我的文件上显示的是 Beaumont，”《上海观察家报》编辑、近期工部局选举落选候选人 A. W. Beaumont 先生昨日在第二特区地方法院接受吴法官（Judge Wo）询问时宣称。

Beaumont 正就2月8日在俄文日报《戈佩伊卡报》（Kopeika）上发表的一篇文章涉嫌诽谤一事，对该报编辑 V. A. Chilikin 提起诉讼。他此前已向法庭承认，他曾用名 Israelovitch。

在 Beaumont 声明其文件上显示的名字为 Beaumont 后，代表 Chilikin 的 K. W. Chang 先生请求法庭要求 Beaumont 出示其文件。

庭审开始时，代表原告的 E. Y. S. Chiang 先生表示，Beaumont 的诉讼基于两段内容，指控称有消息显示，Beaumont 在欧洲停留期间曾与法律发生过某种冲突，且自1932年初以来，Beaumont 一直与一名知名赌徒结伴出入赌场。

与法律的冲突

辩方指出，与法律发生冲突并不一定意味着某人犯了罪；其次，提及 Beaumont 涉嫌出入赌场并非意在诽谤。

应法官要求提供信息来源时，Chilikin 给出了含糊其辞的回答，并请法官免予详述细节。他表示信息来自可靠来源，但拒绝透露姓名。他进一步表示，1927年他在欧洲时，Beaumont 还叫 Israelovitch，并与 Beaumont 有过一笔商业交易往来。

Chilikin 称，上海领事馆存有该欧洲事件的详细资料。他还表示，据可靠消息来源告知，Beaumont 与上海的赌场有关联。

法官随后宣布休庭。

TRANSLATION OF ARTICLES RE BEAUMONT PUBLISHED IN RUSSIAN
NEWSPAPER "KOPPEIKA" ON MARCH 25, 1934.

Hello Beaumont. Isn't it about you?

The letter of Mr. Hessenlopp regarding "qualifications"
of members of the S.M.C. in one of the recent issues of the
influential English newspaper the N.C.D.N., did not remain
without a reply. In yesterday's issue of the above mentioned
paper appeared a letter signed by "Far Cathay", which we submit
herewith :- "Through the columns of your paper I should like
to sincerely thank Mr. Hessenlopp for his excellent letter. As
Mr. Hessenlopp writes, those allowed to be nominated as
candidates for Municipal Honours, should be of good standing
and of irreproachable character. Therefore, it is the duty
of the Council in office at the time nominations for
councillors for the next year are made, to satisfy themselves
that persons nominated are fit and proper persons to act as
Municipal Councillors of our city if so elected. I suggest
that immediate steps be taken to insure that all persons
nominated as candidates for the Municipal election are fit
and proper persons and of irreproachable character, not by
any means a difficult task, as a visit to the respective
candidate's Consular Authorities will quickly clear up any
doubt on the subject. Would it be asked too much, in the
case of a candidate being practically unknown to the majority
of the voters, that he present with his nomination papers a
clean dossier from his Consul-General of this port.

Get out from the list of candidates.

Such was the sense of yesterday's article in the N.C.D.N.

The N.C.D.N. published the following article entitled
"Municipal Candidature":- It is to be feared that the
Consular Body would not welcome the proposal made by a
correspondent who suggested that each candidate for the
Municipal Election should carry a "clearance certificate",
as it were, from his national Consulate. Yet most responsible
pages.zh:
译自1934年3月25日俄文报纸《戈佩伊卡报》（KOPPEIKA）发表的关于 Beaumont 的文章。

你好，Beaumont。这说的不就是你吗？

Hessenlopp 先生在近期一份颇具影响力的英文报纸《华北每日新闻》（N.C.D.N.）上发表的关于工部局董事成员“资格”的信函，并未石沉大海。在上述报纸昨日的版面上，出现了一封署名为“远东亚太”（Far Cathay）的来信，现转载如下：“谨通过贵报版面，衷心感谢 Hessenlopp 先生的精彩来信。正如 Hessenlopp 先生所言，获准提名为工部局荣誉职位候选人的，应当地位良好、品行无瑕。因此，在提名下一年度董事候选人时，现任董事会有责任确保被提名人若当选，确属适合担任本市工部局董事的适当人选。我建议立即采取措施，确保所有被提名为工部局选举候选人的都是品行端正、无可指责的合适人选，这绝非难事，因为只需走访各候选人所属的领事当局，即可迅速消除对此事的任何疑虑。对于大多数选民几乎陌生的候选人，要求其在提交提名文件时附上本国驻沪总领事出具的无不良记录档案，这个要求是否过分？

从候选人名单中滚出去。

这就是《华北每日新闻》昨日文章的主旨。

《华北每日新闻》发表了题为《工部局候选人资格》的以下文章：恐怕领事团不会欢迎一位通讯员提出的建议，即每位工部局选举候选人都应持有一份所谓来自其本国领事馆的“ clearance certificate ”（清关证明/无瑕疵证明）。然而，大多数负责任

pages.en:
- 2 -

people will thoroughly agree with the general principle
enunciated in that letter in endorsement of the views so
forcibly and lucidly expressed by Mr. Hessenlopp. The
candidates, whose addresses will, it is hoped, be available
to readers of this journal to-morrow, are obviously calling
for the confidence of the electorate. In so doing they ask
the electorate to assess their qualities. The electors,
therefore, are seriously charged with the duty of satisfying
themselves that the persons of their choice are men of such
standing as the decencies of public life demand. There is
a good old journalistic rule "when in doubt leave out". It
might apply to the process of balloting. If an elector feels
that he does not know enough of any candidate to be able to
come to a conclusion on this issue, his best course is to
omit that name from his list. Good repute is a quality
better sensed than defined. Men of good repute are required
for the public service.

An attempt is made to prejudice the Russian colony.

The Russian press (by which we mean the "Slovo" and
the "Kpeйxъ") not only does not support Beaumont, but treats
his candidature negatively. We are, however, ready to render
assistance to the "talented" pretender to a seat, not on the
Municipal Council, but on some other Municipal establishment.
The "Slovo" has declared that it has received from
Mr. Beaumont a lengthy circular, full of cheap and bawling
propaganda in his own favor. We decline to publish this
circular. Concluding its comment, the "Slovo" says tersely:-
"We shall positively treat in a negative manner the candidature
of the unknown Mr. Beaumont".

Therefore, the term "Russian Press", to which Trenoff
and other hirelings of Beaumont have made reference, is
represented solely by the paper "Shanghai Zaria", which has
not only published Beaumont's declaration in full but has
pages.zh:
- 2 -

的人士会完全赞同该信中所阐述的一般原则，以此支持 Hessenlopp 先生如此有力且清晰地表达的观点。希望本报读者明日能看到的各位候选人的竞选演说，显然是在呼吁选民的信任。在此过程中，他们要求选民评估他们的品质。因此，选民肩负着严肃的责任，即确认其所选择的人选具备公共生活礼仪所要求的地位。新闻界有一条古老的良好准则：“如有疑虑，予以排除”。这可能也适用于投票过程。如果选民觉得他对任何候选人的了解不足以就此问题做出结论，最好的做法是将该名字从名单中 omit （剔除）。良好的声誉是一种宜于感知而非定义的品质。公共服务需要具有良好声誉的人。

有人试图损害俄侨群体的利益。

俄语报刊（此处指《斯洛沃报》（Slovo）和《克雷赫报》（Kpeйxъ））不仅不支持 Beaumont，反而对其候选人资格持否定态度。不过，我们愿意协助这位“才华横溢”的觊觎者，但不是觊觎工部局董事席位，而是其他某个工部局机构的席位。《斯洛沃报》宣称，它收到了 Beaumont 先生发来的一份长篇通告，里面充满了廉价且大声疾呼的自我吹嘘宣传。我们拒绝刊登此通告。《斯洛沃报》在评论结尾简练地说道：“我们将以肯定的否定态度对待无名之辈 Beaumont 先生的候选人资格”。

因此，Trenoff 和其他 Beaumont 的雇佣文人所说的“俄语报刊”，仅由《上海朝霞报》（Shanghai Zaria）代表，该报不仅全文刊登了 Beaumont 的声明，而且

pages.en:
- 3 -

decorated this declaration with a picture of the "social
worker". If, to the above, we add the previous notices
advertising the character of Beaumont and the conditions
on which Beaumont will agree to accept service on the
Shanghai Municipal Council, then the situation becomes
clearer.

The attitude of the "Shanghai Zaria" will prejudice
the Russian community in the eyes of foreigners who might
become indignant at seeing our colony supporting persons
whose election would be objectionable to any sincere patriot
of Shanghai. Thus, through the tactlessness and thoughtless-
ness of the "oldest emigrant organ" and its series of bluffs,
the entire Russian colony will be made to suffer.

Out of 10 names, 9 are irreproachable.
Who will guarantee the good standing of the 10th?

The identity of the candidate who is "unknown to the
majority of electors" and whose name was not mentioned in
the N.C.D.N's letter, is no secret to any one. His identity
is no less clear in an article published by the same paper
and to whom this letter and article referred. It is easy
to find out the "mysterious" person by the simple process
of elimination. Of the 10 candidates, 7 are present members
of the S.M.C. so they can not be reckoned as "unknown" as they
already have won public confidence. We also eliminate Mr.
Carney, as he was a member of the S.M.C. two years ago.
Therefore there are only two names left - Mr. Liddell whose
domicile is Shanghai and who is the head of a large and well
known firm here, and Beaumont, editor of the "Upstarter", who
arrived in Shanghai in 1930 and is a man of a certain
reputation.

Is it Beaumont?

We make bold to say that all that has been written in
the N.C.D.N. can in no way be connected with Gen. Macfadyen
pages.zh:
- 3 -

用一张“社会工作者”的照片来装饰这份宣言。如果我们在上述内容之外，再加上先前那些宣传博蒙特（Beaumont）为人以及博蒙特同意接受上海工部局董事职位的条件之通告，那么局势就变得更加清晰了。

《上海扎里亚报》（Shanghai Zaria）的态度会使俄国侨民在外籍人士眼中蒙受不利，因为这些外籍人士可能会愤慨地看到，我们的侨民团体竟然支持这样一些人：其当选将是任何真诚的上海爱国者所不能接受的。因此，由于这家“最古老的移民报刊”缺乏策略和思虑不周，以及其一系列虚张声势之举，整个俄国侨民团体都将遭受牵连。

在10个名字中，有9个是无可指责的。
谁来保证第10个人的良好声誉？

那位对“大多数选民来说默默无闻”、且其名字未在《华北每日新闻》（N.C.D.N.）的信函中被提及的候选人的身份，对任何人来说都不是秘密。在同一家报纸发表的、该信函及文章所指涉的文章中，他的身份同样清楚无疑。通过简单的排除法，很容易找出这位“神秘”人物。在10名候选人中，有7人是上海工部局（S.M.C.）的现任董事，因此他们不能被算作“默默无闻”，因为他们已经赢得了公众的信任。我们也排除了卡尼（Carney）先生，因为他两年前曾是上海工部局的董事。因此只剩下两个名字——利德尔（Liddell）先生，他寓居上海，是本地一家大型知名商号的负责人；以及博蒙特，《暴发户》（Upstarter）报的编辑，他于1930年抵达上海，是一位具有一定声誉的人士。

是博蒙特吗？

我们大胆断言，《华北每日新闻》上所写的一切，绝不可能与麦克法迪恩（Macfadyen）将军

pages.en:
- 4 -
or Mr. Arnhold or any other of the candidates except
Beaumont. Therefore, it is evident that Beaumont is
the person whom "Far Cathay" is asking for his Consular
"Clearance Certificate".

Hired agents of Beaumont lie in favor of their master.
The Russian press against unknown Beaumont.

In connection with the above, one of Beaumont's
agents resorted to doubtful means to secure votes for this
"independent candidate". Yesterday the newspaper "Slovo"
wrote the following editorial :- "It has reached the
editor of "Slovo" that a certain Mr. Tronoff is visiting
Russian ratepayers to persuade them to vote for Beaumont
who is being supposedly backed by Russian organisations
and the Russian press including the newspaper 'Slovo'."

The editorial of the "Slovo" definitely announced
that the above mentioned assertions of Mr. Tronoff were
pure fabrications, as the newspaper "Slovo" is not supporting
Mr. Beaumont's candidature.
pages.zh:
- 4 -
或阿诺尔德（Arnhold）先生或除博蒙特以外的任何其他候选人有关。因此，显而易见，博蒙特就是《远东评论》（Far Cathay）要求其提供领事“ clearance certificate ”（译注：此处指无犯罪记录证明或品行证明书）的人。

博蒙特的雇佣代理人为其主人利益行事。
俄国媒体反对默默无闻的博蒙特。

鉴于上述情况，博蒙特的一名代理人采取了可疑手段，为这位“独立候选人”拉取选票。昨天，《斯洛沃报》（Slovo，意为“言论”）发表了以下社论：“《斯洛沃报》编辑获悉，某位特罗诺夫（Tronoff）先生正在拜访俄国纳税人，劝说他们投票给博蒙特，据称博蒙特得到了俄国组织和包括《斯洛沃报》在内的俄国媒体的支持。”

《斯洛沃报》的社论明确宣布，上述特罗诺夫先生的说法纯属捏造，因为《斯洛沃报》并不支持博蒙特先生的候选人资格。

AN ALLEGED

Suit Against Russian
Paper Editor

“KOPEIKA” ARTICLE
RESENTED

Mr. A. W. Beaumont, editor of the
“Shanghai Spectator,” 15 Museum
Road, was the complainant in a
private criminal prosecution heard
in the Second Special District Court
yesterday against Mr. B. A. Chili-
kin, editor of the “Kopeika,” local
Russian-language newspaper with
its office at 785 Avenue Joffre.

Mr. Beaumont, who told the Court
he was a Belgian subject, charged
the Russian journalist with mali-
cious libel, it being alleged that an
article appeared recently in the
“Kopeika,” attacking the complain-
ant’s personal character.

Mr. Eugene Y. B. Kiang, attorney-
at-law, represented Mr. Beaumont
and told the Court that Mr. Chilikin
was charged under Art. 325 of the
Criminal Code. The complainant,
counsel said, was one of the candi-
dates for the Shanghai Municipal
Council, the election to which by the
foreign ratepayers would take place
on March 26 or 27 next. It was
alleged that Mr. Chilikin published
in his paper a long article recently,
saying something about the com-
plainant, which was not based on
facts and which, in the complain-
ant’s opinion, violated Art. 325
of the Criminal Code.

Counsel continued that a copy of
the Russian paper referred to had
been already filed with the Court
together with an English transla-
tion. His client, Mr. Kiang said,
asked for the maximum penalty on
the defendant under Art. 325 and
also demanded to know from what
sources the defendant had obtained
the informations about the com-
plainant.

Defending Mr. Chilikin, Dr. K. W.
Chang, of the law firm of Messrs.
Yen & Co., asked for a copy of the
Russian paper containing the alleged
defamatory writing, saying that the
complainant had not pointed out
which part or parts of the article
were being objected to by him. Dr.
Chang said his client planned coun-
ter-action against the complainant
and that, since the complainant was
declared to be a Belgian subject, he
asked the Court to order him to
produce his certificate of nationality.

This was objected to by Mr. Kiang
on the ground that this had absolute-
ly nothing to do with the case now
before the Court.

Upon being questioned by the
Court which parts of the Russian
paper’s article were resented by his
client, Mr. Kiang asked for an ad-
journment of the hearing so as to
enable him to submit to the Court
a written statement pointing out the
part or parts of the article which,
in his client’s opinion, contained
defamatory matter.

At this juncture, Dr. Chang stated
that his client asked the Court to
subpoena a number of witnesses who
could prove that the article com-
plained of by the complainant con-
tained no defamatory writing. Dr.
Chang also asked the Court to ad-
dress an official letter to Mr. J. E.
Jones, secretary of the Shanghai
Municipal Council, asking him to
come to Court as he could tell
whether the article was based on
facts or not.

The Court subsequently ordered
an adjournment till...

一起涉嫌
诽谤案

起诉俄国
报纸编辑

不满《戈佩伊卡报》
文章

博物馆路15号《上海观察家报》（Shanghai Spectator）编辑 A. W. 博蒙特先生，是昨日在第二特区法院审理的一起私人刑事公诉案件的原告，被告是茹费理路785号当地俄文报纸《戈佩伊卡报》（Kopeika，意为“戈比”）的编辑 B. A. 奇利金（Chilikin）先生。

博蒙特先生告诉法庭他是比利时臣民，他指控这名俄国记者犯有恶意诽谤罪，据称《戈佩伊卡报》最近刊登了一篇文章，攻击原告的个人品格。

律师江庸（Eugene Y. B. Kiang）先生代表博蒙特先生出庭，并告诉法庭，奇利金先生被依据《刑法典》第325条起诉。辩护律师称，原告是上海工部局董事的候选人之一，外籍纳税人的选举将于下月26日或27日举行。据称，奇利金先生最近在其报纸上发表了一篇长文，谈论了有关原告的一些事情，这些内容并非基于事实，且在原告看来，违反了《刑法典》第325条。

辩护律师继续说，所提及的俄文报纸副本连同英文译本已提交法庭存案。江先生说，他的当事人要求根据第325条对被告处以最高刑罚，并要求查明被告是从何处获得关于原告的信息的。

颜惠庆律师事务所（Messrs. Yen & Co.）的张康仁（K. W. Chang）博士为奇利金先生辩护，他要求提供载有涉嫌诽谤文字的俄文报纸副本，称原告并未指出文章中具体哪一部分或哪些部分是他所反对的。张博士说，他的当事人计划对原告采取反诉行动，并且，既然原告声称是比利时臣民，他请求法庭命令原告出示其国籍证明。

江先生对此提出异议，理由是这与法庭目前审理的案件毫无关系。

当法庭询问其当事人对俄文报纸文章的哪些部分感到不满时，江先生请求休庭，以便他能向法庭提交一份书面陈述，指出在他看来包含诽谤内容的文章部分。

此时，张博士表示，他的当事人请求法庭传唤多名证人，以证明原告所投诉的文章中不包含诽谤性文字。张博士还请求法庭致函上海工部局秘书 J. E. 琼斯（J. E. Jones）先生，请他出庭，因为他可以说明该文章是否基于事实。

D 207
THE CHINA PRESS, SUNDAY, MARCH 11, 1934

Beaumont Of
'Spectator' Sues
Russ For Libel

Kopeika Editor Prints
Objectionable Story
Of Election Dark Horse

Uncomplimentary Dope
On History Rouses Ire

The hearing of a suit charging
malicious libel brought by Mr. A. W.
Beaumont, 67, Belgian, editor of
the Shanghai Spectator, against Mr.
V. A. Chilikin, 41, Russian, editor
of the Kopeika, Russian daily,
opened before Judge Wo in the
Second Special District Court yes-
terday morning. Mr. Chilikin is
alleged to have published a falsely
fabricated and ridiculous biography
of A. W. Beaumont in the issue of
the Kopeika of February 8, attack-
ing the personal character of Mr.
Beaumont.

After the case had been outlined
by Beaumont's attorney, Mr. Eugene
Y. B. Klang, a reply was made by
Mr. H. W. Chang on behalf of
Chilikin, requesting Beaumont's at-
torney to submit to the court a
separate list containing all the
important passages on which his
client bases his claim for defama-
tion of character. The court then
ordered Beaumont's attorney to sub-
mit the petition and adjourned the
case sine die.

Mr. Beaumont announced his in-
tentions some time ago of submitting
himself for election as a member
of the Shanghai Municipal Council
at the coming elections this month.
The two articles published in the
Kopeika on February 7 and 8, pur-
port to give his past history, and
state that his real name is not
Beaumont, but "Ismailovich"; they
further allege that he was deport-
ed from the United States.

It is Beaumont's intentions to
have the case completed as soon
as possible and to disprove the state-
ments so as not to spoil his chances
in the forthcoming election, while
Chilikin and his attorney also wish
to press the case as they maintain
that it is in the public interest that
these matters should be brought to
light.

The Kopeika then mentions that
Beaumont turned to the journalis-
tic field and now appears in the
role of editor and publisher of The
Shanghai Spectator. It also refers
to Beaumont's attempt in February,
1932, to run a tabloid, The Daily
Express. Apart from his other in-
terests at the present time the
Kopeika mentioned in its article
that Beaumont was connected with
the Studio D'Art, furniture dealers,
from whom he is declared to re-
ceive a commission for furniture
sold through him or with his help.

In declaring that Beaumont's real
name is Adolf Israilovich, the
Kopeika states that he was born
in Belgium on March 4, 1897, of
Polish-Jewish parentage.

After Beaumont informed the
court that in order to save time
in interpretation he would like to
leave the matter in the hands of
his attorney, Mr. Klang told the
court that his client was a respected
member of the local foreign com-
munity and that he was to be a
candidate for the coming municipal
elections. Last month, Mr. Klang
said, Beaumont was bitterly at-
tacked by Chilikin, who, he said,
published slanderous articles against
him in the Russian daily, the
Kopeika.

Mr. Klang concluded his opening
address by requesting the court to
mete out adequate punishment to
Chilikin and also to attempt to
trace the origin of the slanderous
news. Copies of the paper with
translations in both English and
Chinese were handed to the court.

In replying on behalf of Chilikin
Mr. Chang asked the court to in-
struct the plaintiff to point out the
passages which he considered defa-
matory to his reputation. Mr.
Chang requested also that the court
should write a letter to Mr. J. R.
Jones, the secretary of the Shanghai
Municipal Council, in order to as-
certain through him whether or not
the alleged slanderous statements
were true. Mr. Chang also told the
court that he would subpoena wit-
nesses to testify regarding these
matters.

Before closing, Mr. Chang assert-
ed that if Beaumont is a respectable
subject, he should produce his pass-
port and show if the name "Beau-
mont" is on it or not.

The hearing was adjourned sine
die in order that Mr. Klang, Beau-
mont's attorney, should have time
to prepare a detailed petition.

D 207
《字林西报》（The China Press），1934年3月11日，星期日

《观察家报》的
博蒙特起诉
俄国人诽谤

《戈佩伊卡报》编辑刊登
关于选举黑马的
令人反感的故事

关于其历史的负面消息
激起愤怒

昨日早晨，伍法官在第二特区法院开庭审理了一起由67岁的比利时人、《上海观察家报》编辑 A. W. 博蒙特先生提起的恶意诽谤诉讼，被告是41岁的俄国人、俄文日报《戈佩伊卡报》编辑 V. A. 奇利金先生。据称，奇利金在2月8日的《戈佩伊卡报》上刊登了一篇虚假捏造且荒谬的 A. W. 博蒙特传记，攻击博蒙特先生的个人品格。

在博蒙特的律师江庸（Eugene Y. B. Klang，注：此处原文拼写为Klang，前文为Kiang，均指同一人）概述案情后，代表奇利金的 H. W. 张（H. W. Chang，注：即前文张康仁）先生作出回应，请求博蒙特的律师向法庭提交一份单独列表，列出其当事人据以主张人格诽谤的所有重要段落。法庭随后命令博蒙特的律师提交诉状，并将案件无限期延期。

博蒙特先生此前曾宣布，他打算在本月即将到来的选举中竞选上海工部局董事。《戈佩伊卡报》于2月7日和8日发表的两篇文章， purportedly （译注：声称）披露了他的过往历史，并称他的真名不是博蒙特，而是“伊斯梅洛维奇”（Ismailovich）；文章还进一步声称他被美国驱逐出境。

博蒙特意图尽快结案并驳斥这些说法，以免破坏他在即将到来的选举中的机会，而奇利金及其律师也希望推进此案，因为他们坚持认为，将这些事情公之于众符合公共利益。

《戈佩伊卡报》接着提到，博蒙特投身新闻界，现在以《上海观察家报》编辑和出版人的身份出现。文章还提及博蒙特在1932年2月尝试经营一份小报《每日快报》（The Daily Express）。除了他目前的其它兴趣外，《戈佩伊卡报》在文章中提到，博蒙特与家具商“艺术工作室”（Studio D'Art）有关联，据称他通过自己或在其帮助下销售的家具收取佣金。

在宣称博蒙特的真名是阿道夫·伊斯赖洛维奇（Adolf Israilovich）时，《戈佩伊卡报》称他于1897年3月4日出生在比利时，父母是波兰犹太人。

博蒙特告知法庭，为了节省翻译时间，他希望将此事宜交由其律师处理，随后江先生告诉法庭，他的当事人是本地外籍社群中受人尊敬的成员，并且是即将举行的市政选举的候选人。江先生说，上个月，博蒙特遭到奇利金的猛烈攻击，后者在俄文日报《戈佩伊卡报》上刊登了针对他的诽谤文章。

江先生在开场陈述的最后，请求法庭对奇利金施以适当的惩罚，并试图追查诽谤消息的来源。带有英文和中文译本的报纸副本已呈交法庭。

在代表奇利金答辩时，张先生请求法庭指示原告指出他认为损害其名誉的段落。张先生还请求法庭致函上海工部局秘书 J. R. 琼斯（J. R. Jones，注：前文为J. E. Jones）先生，以便通过他核实所谓的诽谤陈述是否属实。张先生还告诉法庭，他将传唤证人就这些事发作证。

在结束发言前，张先生断言，如果博蒙特是一位体面的臣民，他应该出示护照，以显示上面是否有“博蒙特”这个名字。

听证会无限期延期，以便博蒙特的律师江先生有时间准备详细的诉状。

（批：填写）
（批：J.C. 特别分部）
（批：协议）
（批：08X 143.）

SECRET
Case of R. W. Beaumont against V. A. Chilikin,
Editor of Russian Journal 'Kopeika'.

In accordance with instructions received, the
undermentioned persons were interviewed by D. I. Ross
in connection with the private criminal prosecution case
of libel brought by A. W. Beaumont against V. A. Chilikin,
Russian, editor of the Russian daily 'Kopeika' with the
following results:-

Inquiries at the American Consulate-General on
6.3.34 confirmed the information already in our possession
that A.W. Beaumont, whose real name is A. Israelowicz, was
deported from the United States of America on the ground
of illegal entry. The warrant of deportation No.55650-677
dated 28.3.29, bears the following particulars:-
"Born April 22, 1901, at Bukharest, Romania.
"Last arrival in U.S.A. at Blaine, Washington.
"Departure April 30, 1929, from Victoria, B.C."

This information was obtained on the understanding
that it would be treated as confidential and that it would
not be utilized in any manner calculated to embarrass the
American Authorities as Beaumont is not recognized as an
American citizen.

Mr. L. Del□□□, Belgian Vice-Consul, upon being
approached on 6.3.34, stated that although A.W. Beaumont's
real name was A. Israelowicz, he is registered with the
Belgian Consulate under the aforementioned name. Regarding
Beaumont's antecedents and activities he declined to talk
and intimated that he would only divulge same upon receipt
of an official letter. This information, however, he
stated would only be supplied on the condition that it
would be treated as a strictly confidential document.
In conclusion he declared with emphasis that he does not
want the Belgian Authorities in China to be involved in
the present private criminal prosecution which has been

（批：Original reply
forwarded to M.G.
by D.I.Ross 8/3/34

机密
R. W. Beaumont 诉 V. A. Chilikin 案，
俄文期刊《戈比》（Kopeika）编辑。

根据所获指示，D. I. Ross 就 A. W. Beaumont 对俄国人、俄文日报《戈比》编辑 V. A. Chilikin 提起的私人刑事诽谤起诉案，讯问了下列人员，结果如下：-

1934年3月6日在美国总领事馆进行的查询证实了我们已掌握的信息，即 A.W. Beaumont（真名为 A. Israelowicz）因非法入境被美利坚合众国驱逐出境。日期为1929年3月28日的第55650-677号驱逐令载有以下详情：-
“1901年4月22日出生于罗马尼亚布加勒斯特。
“最后一次抵达美国地点为华盛顿州布莱恩。
“1929年4月30日从不列颠哥伦比亚省维多利亚离境。”

获取此信息的前提是将其视为机密，且不得以任何可能使美国当局感到难堪的方式加以利用，因为 Beaumont 不被承认为美国公民。

1934年3月6日接洽比利时副领事 L. Del□□□ 先生时，他表示，尽管 A.W. Beaumont 的真名是 A. Israelowicz，但他以上述姓名在比利时领事馆注册。关于 Beaumont 的背景和活动，他拒绝谈论，并暗示只有在收到正式信函后才会 divulge（披露）这些信息。然而，他表示提供这些信息的前提是必须将其作为严格机密文件处理。最后，他 emphatically（强调）声明，他不希望比利时在华当局卷入目前由

pages.en:
filed by Beaumont against the Russian newspaper 'Kopeika.'
On 6.3.34 Mr. H. Sandor, General Manager of the
Asia Realty Coy., was interviewed. He states that in
spite of the unwarranted and unjustifiable articles
published by Beaumont in the issues of the "Spectator"
of June 22 and 29, 1933, respectively, attacking the
company, he has absolutely no desire either to appear or
to send a representative to court in connection with this
case. Moreover he contends that by testifying it would
only be detrimental to the company's interests, and in
view of the fact that libel does not constitute an offence
under Belgian law, he therefore, in order to avoid reprisals
from Beaumont through the medium of his journal, has no
wish to have his concern's affairs aired in Court.
On the same date a visit was paid to Miss
Margaret Kennedy, American, keeper of a brothel at 473
Kiangse Road, at her residence at 1321 Rue Lafayette.
While admitting that the article contained in the 'Spectator'
of September 21, 1933, refers to her it was, she declares,
inspired by animosity, and even though she holds two
chits for $20. each, for "services rendered", signed by
Beaumont sometime during 1931 (at 14 Soochow Road), she
is unwilling to appear in Court as she does not wish to
antagonize this individual. Major Holcomb, Miss
Kennedy's legal advisor, who retains the chits in question,
upon being interviewed in connection with this matter,
declared that as the article in question had caused
his client untold misery and worry, he would naturally
advise Miss Kennedy to refrain from appearing as a witness
in this case.
On 7.3.34 Mr. J. Gaiffard, French Consul, upon
being approached, stated that Beaumont under the name of
Israelevitch, while in Paris during 1928, was the
instigator of a 3,000,000 Francs fraud (jewels, precious
pages.zh:
Beaumont 针对俄文报纸《戈比》提起的私人刑事诉讼。
1934年3月6日，亚洲地产公司（Asia Realty Coy.）总经理 H. Sandor 先生接受讯问。他表示，尽管 Beaumont 分别在1933年6月22日和29日的《旁观者》（Spectator）期刊上刊登了攻击该公司的毫无根据且无理的文章，但他绝对无意出庭或派代表出庭参与此案。此外，他认为作证只会损害公司利益，鉴于根据比利时法律诽谤不构成犯罪，因此，为了避免通过 Beaumont 的期刊遭到其报复，他不希望将公司事务在法庭上公开。
同日，走访了居住在拉斐德路1321号的美国人 Margaret Kennedy 小姐，她是江西路473号一家妓院的经营者。她承认1933年9月21日《旁观者》上的文章是指向她本人的，但她宣称该文章是出于恶意而写；尽管她持有两张 Beaumont 于1931年间在苏州路14号签署的、每张面值20美元的“服务费”欠条，但她不愿出庭，因为她不想与此人结怨。Kennedy 小姐的法律顾问 Holcomb 少校持有上述欠条，他在就此事项接受讯问时表示，由于有关文章给他的当事人带来了无尽的痛苦和担忧，他自然建议 Kennedy 小姐不要在此案中作为证人出庭。
1934年3月7日，法国领事 J. Gaiffard 先生在接受接洽时表示，Beaumont 在1928年身处巴黎期间，以 Israelevitch 之名，策划了一起针对 Blumenthal 公司的300万法郎诈骗案（珠宝、贵重

stones, etc.) upon the firm of Messrs. Blumenthal. Upon

principal persons likely to be of any use to the defense
in this case are reluctant to appear as witnesses as

Israelowics, was born at Antwerp, Belgium, on March 4,
1897 of Polish parents. His father's name (Deceased)
was Maurice Israelowicz and his mother's maiden name

Ever since its inception, some two years ago
Beaumont has been connected with the Studio d'Art, 126
Bubbling Well Road. Beaumont was very active in having this
company registered with the United States Consulate-General,
but is not, as he pretends to be, actually on the Board of
Directors. The real owner of this company is one Chang who
resides at House No.2 Passage No.34 Route Paul Henri and
Beaumont receives a commission on all business which he is
able to introduce to the firm.

It is believed that he owes money to various business
concerns in Shanghai and in April 1932 it was known for a
fact that he owed $305 to Mrs. E. Lipkovsky, wife of the
Siberian Jewellery Store Proprietor, for dresses supplied
in the early months of 1932 to the alleged Mrs. Beaumont,
with whom he was then residing at Flat G2 Hotel Monchen,
Bubbling Well Road.

In October or November of 1932 Beaumont was convicted
at the local Belgian Consulate-General in an action for
defamation of character brought by one B.S. Barbash, a
Russian money lender of 467 Kiangse Road and was sentenced
to 10 days imprisonment, which was later commuted to a fine,
as it is against the policy of the Belgian authorities to
enforce prison sentences save in very serious cases.

years ago in Paris (N.B. This statement has been confirmed

自大约两年前成立以来，Beaumont 一直与位于静安寺路126号的艺术工作室（Studio d'Art）有关联。Beaumont 在促使该公司在美国总领事馆注册方面非常活跃，但实际上并不像他自称的那样是董事会成员。该公司的真正所有者是一位姓 Chang 的人，居住在保罗亨利路34弄2号，Beaumont 从他为该公司引入的所有业务中收取佣金。

据信他欠上海各家商号款项，1932年4月，已知确凿事实是他欠西伯利亚珠宝店店主之妻 E. Lipkovsky 夫人305美元，这是1932年初为所谓的 Beaumont 夫人供应服装的费用，当时他与该女子同居于静安寺路蒙辰公寓（Hotel Monchen）G2室。

1932年10月或11月，Beaumont 在当地比利时总领事馆因江西路467号俄国放债人 B.S. Barbash 提起的名誉诽谤诉讼中被定罪，并被判处10天监禁，后减为罚款，因为除非在非常严重的案件中，否则执行监禁判决不符合比利时当局的政策。
罚款已支付。

几年前，Beaumont 还在巴黎因欺诈罪被缺席定罪（注：此陈述已得到当地法国当局证实，他们补充说从未尝试引渡 Beaumont）。

Information from a reliable source indicated that
several complaints had been made against this individual
regarding the non-payment of debts. In this connection the
Belgian Authorities summoned Beaumont to the Consulate for
purposes of questioning and admonition. Beaumont promised
to pay off his debtors at the rate of $40 per month.

In early January 1933 it became known that Beaumont
was an acquaintance of one "Jimmy" Llade, a notorious
gambler and conductor of various gambling dens throughout
the Settlement and the French Concession. Beaumont was
seen to visit the Pacific Club, 58a Hart Road, several
times during January of this year.

A week or so ago a certain Russian who alleged that
he formerly was an employee of the Asia Realty Co., visited
the Belgian Consulate-General and said that he had revealed
to Beaumont certain facts about the company, and that he feared
that Beaumont was going to use them in an article in the
"Spectator". Summoned to the Consulate for interrogation
about this report, Beaumont admitted that he had prepared
such an article, but stated that before publishing it he
would obtain Dr. Sellett's approval, as he did not wish to
offend American susceptibilities. The statements he had
made about the Asia Realty Co. were true, he stated, and
after Dr. Sellett had seen the article he (the latter)
saw no objection to it.

The article in question was published in the "Spectator"
dated June 22, 1933, and according to information received
was greatly objected to by the company. The article however
being true does not constitute libel under Belgium law.
A further article regarding the activities of the Asia
Realty Co. was published in an issue of the "Spectator"
dated June 29, 1933.

1933年1月初，获悉 Beaumont 是“Jimmy” Llade 的熟人，后者是一名臭名昭著的赌徒，在整个租界和法租界经营多家赌场。今年1月期间，有人多次看到 Beaumont 访问哈特路58a号的太平洋俱乐部。

约一周前，一名声称曾是亚洲地产公司雇员的俄国人访问了比利时总领事馆，称他向 Beaumont 透露了关于该公司的一些事实，并担心 Beaumont 会在《旁观者》的一篇文章中使用这些事实。Beaumont 因这一报告被传唤至领事馆接受讯问，他承认已准备了这样一篇文章，但表示在发表之前他会征得 Sellett 博士的批准，因为他不想冒犯美国人的情感。他表示，他对亚洲地产公司所做的陈述是真实的，并且在 Sellett 博士看过文章后，后者表示没有异议。

有关文章刊登在1933年6月22日的《旁观者》上，据收到的信息，该公司对此强烈反对。然而，由于文章内容属实，根据比利时法律不构成诽谤。
另一篇关于亚洲地产公司活动的文章刊登在1933年6月29日的《旁观者》上。

自大约两年前成立以来，博蒙特一直与静安寺路126号的 Studio d'Art 有关联。博蒙特在促使该公司在美国总领事馆注册方面非常活跃，但他实际上并非如他所假装的那样是董事会成员。该公司的真正所有者是一个姓张的人，居住在保罗亨利路34弄2号，博蒙特从他为该公司引入的所有业务中收取佣金。

据信他欠上海各家商号款项，且1932年4月有确凿消息表明，他欠西伯利亚珠宝店店主之妻 E. Lipkovsky 夫人305美元，这是1932年初为所谓的博蒙特夫人提供服装的费用，当时他与该女子同居于静安寺路蒙辰公寓62室。

1932年10月或11月，博蒙特在当地比利时总领事馆因一起由江西路467号的俄罗斯放债人 B.S. Barbash 提起的名誉诽谤诉讼中被判有罪，并被判处监禁10天，后改为罚款，因为除非在极严重的案件中，否则执行监禁判决不符合比利时当局的政策。罚款已支付。

几年前，博蒙特还在巴黎因欺诈罪被缺席定罪（注：此陈述已由当地法国当局证实，他们补充说，甚至未曾尝试引渡博蒙特）。

Information from a reliable source indicated that
several complaints had been made against this individual
regarding the non-payment of debts. In this connection the
Belgian Authorities summoned Beaumont to the Consulate for
purposes of questioning and admonition. Beaumont promised
to pay off his debtors at the rate of $40 per month.

In early January 1933 it became known that Beaumont
was an acquaintance of one "Jimmy" Liado, a notorious
gambler and conductor of various gambling dens throughout
the Settlement and the French Concession. Beaumont was
seen to visit the Pacific Club, 58a Hart Road, several
times during January of this year.

A week or so ago a certain Russian who alleged that
he formerly was an employee of the Asia Realty Co., visited
the Belgian Consulate-General and said that he had revealed
to Beaumont certain facts about the company, and that he feared
that Beaumont was going to use them in an article in the
"Spectator". Summoned to the Consulate for interrogation
about this report, Beaumont admitted that he had prepared
such an article, but stated that before publishing it he
would obtain Dr. Sellett's approval, as he did not wish to
offend American susceptibilities. The statements he had
made about the Asia Realty Co. were true, he stated, and
after Dr. Sellett had seen the article he (the latter)
saw no objection to it.

The article in question was published in the "Spectator"
dated June 22, 1933, and according to information received
was greatly objected to by the company. The article however
being true does not constitute libel under Belgium law.
A further article regarding the activities of the Asia
Realty Co. was published in an issue of the "Spectator"
dated June 29, 1933.

来自可靠渠道的消息表明，已有多起针对此人拖欠债务的投诉。就此，比利时当局传唤博蒙特到领事馆进行讯问和训诫。博蒙特承诺每月偿还债权人40美元。

1933年1月初，获悉博蒙特与一名叫“Jimmy” Liado（音译）的人相识，此人是臭名昭著的赌徒，并在整个租界及法租界经营多家赌场。今年1月期间，有人多次看到博蒙特访问哈特路58a号的太平洋俱乐部。

约一周前，一名自称曾是亚洲地产公司（Asia Realty Co.）雇员的俄罗斯人访问了比利时总领事馆，称他向博蒙特透露了关于该公司的一些事实，并担心博蒙特会在《观察家报》的一篇文章中使用这些信息。博蒙特因这一报告被传唤至领事馆接受讯问，他承认已准备了这样一篇文章，但表示在发表之前他会获得 Sellett 博士的批准，因为他不想冒犯美国人的情感。他表示，他对亚洲地产公司所做的陈述是真实的，并且在 Sellett 博士看过文章后，后者表示没有异议。

相关文章刊登在1933年6月22日的《观察家报》上，据收到的消息，该公司对此强烈反对。然而，由于文章内容属实，根据比利时法律不构成诽谤。另一篇关于亚洲地产公司活动的文章刊登在1933年6月29日的《观察家报》上。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
Translation from the "KOPEIKA" of February 16, 1934. 3307
Dec 19/2/3rd

GENTLEMEN § HE FEELS OFFENDED!

The "benefactor" of the Russian community
decided to punish the "Kopeika".

It appears that Mr. Beaumont, the candidate for the
the post of municipal councillor, has adopted a wrong
attitude towards our statement regarding his person, to
make which it was a natural thing on our part.

As our readers already know, the publishing of the
information in question was undertaken by the "Kopeika" in
order to acquaint the voters with the person of Mr. Beaumont
who stands for election: being supported in this by the
force and the authority of two votes: his own and that of
the "Shanghai Zaria".

To our great regret he felt offended by our statement
and instructed his legal adviser to handle this matter. We
are in receipt of the following letter :-

"Sir,
Mr. A.W. Beaumont, my client, called at my
office and stated that an article had been
published in the "Kopeika", in which his
private life was discussed, and that the
data contained in the article in question
are false. Apart from instituting criminal
prosecution I am instructed to warn you to
cease further publishing of articles of a
similar nature.
Eugene E.V. Kiang."

Thus, we are advised to cease further publishing of
articles "of a similar nature", i.e. articles discussing Mr.
Beaumont's chances as a candidate for election.

Such modesty on the part of a person, who has a
serious intention of becoming a councillor of the Shanghai
Municipal Council and who at the same time does not wish
his name to be mentioned in vain in the press, seems to us
extremely strange.

If Mr. Beaumont considers himself a suitable candidate
for the post of a city father of a city like Shanghai, he
must know better than anybody else that discussing by the
population of his candidature is absolutely inseparable from
discussing of all data relating to his person.

The population of Shanghai has the full right to
know everything about the candidates, and nothing can be
hushed up.

Mr. Beaumont had no reason to presume that idiots
predominate in Shanghai who are capable of electing in the
Municipal Council the first man in the street, who wishes
to become a councillor, without first making enquiries as
to who this man is.

This is a customary thing to do not only in Shanghai
but throughout the whole world, and we have not yet heard of
any vagabond who, instead of attracting the attention of the
criminal department of the police, has attracted the attention
of municipal electors, while dead silence reigned in the

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别分部登记处。
译自1934年2月16日的《戈佩卡报》（KOPEIKA）。编号 3307
19/2/33年12月19日

先生们 § 他感到受辱！

俄国社区的“恩人”决定惩罚《戈佩卡报》。

看来，博蒙特先生这位市议员候选人，对我们关于他个人的声明采取了错误的态度，而发表该声明是我们自然而然的做法。

正如我们的读者已经知道的那样，《戈佩卡报》发布相关信息是为了让选民了解参加选举的博蒙特先生的为人；在此过程中，我们得到了两票的力量和权威的支持：即他自己的一票以及《上海查里亚报》（Shanghai Zaria）的一票。

令我们深感遗憾的是，他感到我们的声明冒犯了他，并指示其法律顾问处理此事。我们收到了如下信件：

“先生，
我的客户 A.W. 博蒙特先生来到我的办公室，指出《戈佩卡报》刊登了一篇文章，讨论了他的私生活，并且该文章中包含的数据是虚假的。除了提起刑事诉讼外，我还受命警告你们停止进一步发表类似性质的文章。
Eugene E.V. Kiang.”

因此，我们被建议停止进一步发表“类似性质”的文章，即讨论博蒙特先生作为选举候选人的机会的文章。

对于一个 seriously 意图成为上海公共租界工部局董事，同时又不希望自己的名字在报纸上被无端提及的人来说，这种谦逊显得极其奇怪。

如果博蒙特先生认为自己适合担任像上海这样的城市的“城市之父”（即市政官员）职位，他应该比任何人都更清楚，民众对其候选资格的讨论与对其个人所有相关数据的讨论是绝对不可分割的。

上海民众有充分的权利了解关于候选人的一切，没有任何事情可以被掩盖。

博蒙特先生没有理由假定上海充斥着傻瓜，这些人会在不先调查此人是谁的情况下，就在工部局选举中选出街上第一个想成为董事的人。

这不仅在上海，而且在全世界都是惯例，我们尚未听说过有任何流浪汉，在没有引起警方刑事部门注意的情况下，却吸引了市政选民的注意，而媒体对此保持死一般的沉默。

7

pages.en:
(2)

This is a customary thing to do not only in Shanghai
but throughout the whole world, and we have not yet heard of
any vagabond who, instead of attracting the attention of the
criminal department of the police, has attracted the attention
of municipal electors, while dead silence reigned in the
press on the subject.

It was not our wish that Mr. Beaumont should stand
for election. He did so on his own wish, without any advice
or assistance on our part. We were put before an accomplished
fact and it only remained to us to fulfil our duty in
discussing this unexpected candidature.

So we did. However, our first article containing
information on this subject aroused serious objections on the
part of the candidate and a strong intervention on the part
of his legal adviser followed.

If the further discussion of the subject in question
will follow this course, we are afraid that we shall have to
spend more time in court than in writing and publishing
articles.

Nevertheless, being aware of our duties, we are
compelled to submit to this necessity as long as it cannot
be avoided without suppressing full information regarding
Mr. Beaumont as a candidate for the Shanghai Municipal Council.

In accordance with the above we have instructed Mr.
K.V. Chang, our legal adviser, to send the following reply to
Mr. Beaumont's legal adviser :-

"Sir,
I am directed by Mr. V.A. Chilikin, my client,
to acknowledge receipt of the letter you wrote
on behalf of Mr. W.A. Beaumont.

In reply my client states that his actions
were perfectly legitimate and that they are
not subject to any restrictions on the part
of your clients.

The question, whether or not the "Kopeika's"
statement was false will be decided in court.

Further, Mr. V.A.Chilikin wishes to state
that he pays no attention to your letter and
will in future throw similar letters into the
waste-paper basket."

Yours faithfully,

K.V. Chang. "
pages.zh:
(2)

这不仅在上海，而且在全世界都是惯例，我们尚未听说过有任何流浪汉，在没有引起警方刑事部门注意的情况下，却吸引了市政选民的注意，而媒体对此保持死一般的沉默。

我们并不希望博蒙特先生参加选举。他是出于自愿这样做的，没有得到我们的任何建议或帮助。我们面对的是既成事实，剩下的只是履行我们的职责，讨论这一意外的候选资格。

所以我们做了。然而，我们第一篇包含相关信息的文章引起了候选人的严重反对，随后他的法律顾问进行了强力干预。

如果对该主题的进一步讨论将遵循这一进程，我们担心我们将不得不花费更多的时间在法庭上，而不是在撰写和发表文章上。

尽管如此，意识到我们的职责，只要无法在不压制关于博蒙特先生作为上海公共租界工部局董事候选人的完整信息的情况下避免这种情况，我们就被迫服从这一必要性。

根据上述情况，我们已指示我们的法律顾问 K.V. Chang 先生向博蒙特先生的法律顾问发送以下回复：

“先生，
我受我的客户 V.A. Chilikin 先生指示，确认收到您代表 W.A. 博蒙特先生写的来信。

作为回复，我的客户声明，他的行为完全合法，不受贵方客户的任何限制。

《戈佩卡报》的声明是否虚假，将由法庭裁决。

此外，V.A. Chilikin 先生希望声明，他不理会您的信件，将来会将类似的信件扔进废纸篓。”

此致，

K.V. Chang。”

Il est arrivé, le 14 Juin 1929, à Shanghai, venant de Vancouver,
à bord du vapeur "Empress of Russia", sous le nom de A.W. BEAUMONT, su-
jet Belge.
Descendu à l'Astor House, BEAUMONT a quitté, il y a quelque temps,
cet Hôtel, pour aller habiter dans le "Foreign Y.M.C.A. Building", No.38,
Bubbling Well road. Il occupe la chambre No· 418.
BEAUMONT travaille actuellement à l'organisation d'un Cercle Sportif
sous le nom de "Riverview Golf Course", qui doit être situé à Ying Hsiam
Kong, au terminus de Yangzepoo road, près de la Route de Woosung (sur
la limite de la Concession Internationale) et dont les bureaux provisoi-
res sont installés au No· 6, Kiukiang road.
Cette activité de BEAUMONT a fait l'objet d'une enquête discrète

ble à cause des capitaux à investir./.
Le sieur ISRAELEVITCH est l'auteur d'une escroquerie de 3.000.000Frs
environ, commise en 1928, au préjudice de la maison Blumenthal (bijoux,
pierres précieuses, etc.,) à Paris.

In 1928 ISRAELEVITCH was the instigator of a 3,000,000 francs

Blumenthal being the sufferers.

ISRAELEVITCH 先生，化名 A.W. BEAUMONT，于 1928 年 7 月左右被从美国驱逐至加拿大。
他于 1929 年 6 月 14 日乘坐“俄罗斯皇后号”（Empress of Russia）轮船，以比利时籍公民 A.W. BEAUMONT 之名，从温哥华抵达上海。
BEAUMONT 初抵时下榻于礼查饭店（Astor House），但不久前已离开该饭店，迁居至静安寺路 38 号青年会大楼（Foreign Y.M.C.A. Building）。他现居住于 418 号房间。
BEAUMONT 目前正致力于组织一个名为“江湾高尔夫球场”（Riverview Golf Course）的体育俱乐部，该俱乐部拟选址于杨树浦路终点附近的引翔港（Ying Hsiam Kong），靠近吴淞路（位于公共租界边界），其临时办事处设于九江路 6 号。
国际巡捕房对 BEAUMONT 的这一活动进行了秘密调查，警方认为，由于所需投入资本巨大，该项目并不可行。
ISRAELEVITCH 先生是 1928 年在巴黎对 Blumenthal 商行（经营珠宝、宝石等）实施的一起约 3,000,000 法郎诈骗案的始作俑者。

1928 年，ISRAELEVITCH 在巴黎策划了一起金额达 3,000,000 法郎的欺诈案（涉及珠宝、宝石等），Blumenthal 先生们是受害者。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3307
Date 1 / 2 / 34

TRANSLATION FROM "KOPEIKA" OF FEBRUARY 8, 1934.

BIOGRAPHY OF RUSSIAN COMMUNITY'S "BENEFACTOR."

Who is Beaumont, recommended by the
"Shanghai Zaria" for the post of
Municipal Councillor.

As we stated in our yesterday's issue, the circumstances
under which Mr. Beaumont, Editor of the "Spectator,"
decided to stand for election into the Shanghai Municipal
Council, demand that large circles of readers be acquainted
in detail with the personality of Mr. Beaumont.

This procedure is inevitable in the course of all
elections of importance and, before he decided to put
forward his candidature, Mr. Beaumont certainly had
reconciled himself with the prospect of large circles of
voters being made acquainted with his personality.

In this respect we are meeting Mr. Beaumont and the
general public half-way by publishing the following
information regarding him, which we have obtained from
absolutely authoritative sources.

X X X

The person at present known in Shanghai as Adolf
Weissman Beaumont has another name, which also can be
regarded as his real name - "Adolf Israilevitch."

He is of Polish-Jewish origin. His father, a native
of Poland and married to a Polish Jewess, migrated to
Belgium where, on March 4, 1897, the future candidate for
the Shanghai Municipal Council, Adolf Israilevitch-Beaumont,
was born. Later he stated that he was a naturalized
American citizen.

HE IS A BELGIAN!

However, the local American Consulate denied this claim.
Mr. Beaumont then registered with the Belgian Consulate and
since February 20, 1930, has been in possession of a Belgian
passport.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
中央捕房登记科
编号 D 3307
日期 1934 年 2 月 1 日

译自 1934 年 2 月 8 日《戈佩卡报》（KOPEIKA）。

俄国侨民“恩人”传记。

谁是《上海朝霞报》推荐担任工部局董事一职的 Beaumont 先生。

正如我们在昨日版次中所述，Beaumont 先生——《观察家报》（Spectator）编辑——决定竞选上海工部局董事的情况，要求广大读者详细了解 Beaumont 先生的为人。

在所有重要选举过程中，这一程序是不可避免的；在决定提出候选人资格之前，Beaumont 先生肯定已经接受让广大选民了解其个人情况的预期。

在这方面，我们通过发布以下从绝对权威来源获取的关于他的信息，来迎合 Beaumont 先生和公众的需求。

X X X

目前在上海以 Adolf Weissman Beaumont 之名闻名的人士还有另一个名字，也可视为其真名——“Adolf Israilevitch”。

他具有波兰犹太血统。其父系波兰人，娶了一位波兰犹太女子为妻，后移居比利时。未来的上海工部局董事候选人 Adolf Israilevitch-Beaumont 于 1897 年 3 月 4 日出生于此地。后来他声称自己是归化美国公民。

他是比利时人！

然而，当地美国领事馆否认了这一说法。随后，Beaumont 先生在比利时领事馆注册，并自 1930 年 2 月 20 日起持有比利时护照。

pages.en:
(2)

DEPORTED FROM AMERICA

The attention of certain "public bodies" was first
attracted to Mr. Beaumont following his arrival in Shanghai
from the U.S.A. on June 14, 1929. Later it was learned
that Beaumont had illegally entered that country from
Victoria, Canada. He arrived in Victoria in June 1929
and soon afterwards went over the frontier into the U.S.A.,
where he was detained. He was subsequently deported to
Shanghai.

TWICE BORN

Order No. 55650-677, on the authority of which Beaumont
was deported from the U.S.A., contains the following
paragraphs:-

"Born April 22, 1901, at Bukarest, Rumania.
Entered the U.S.A. at Blaine, Washington.
Departure: April 30, 1929, from Victoria,
British Canada."

It is presumed that the information regarding this new
place
and new date of birth of Mr. Beaumont was taken from
documents presented by the latter.

WHERE WAS HE BORN?

If this was the case, the information in question
contradicts the original version regarding the date and
place of birth of the future candidate for the post of
the Municipal Councillor, the difference being several
degrees of latitude and several years in time.

A BELGIAN RUMANIAN OR A RUMANIAN BELGIAN?

Thus, insofar as Mr. Beaumont is registered with the
Belgian Consulate at Shanghai, we can presume that he is
in possession of birth certificates and papers establishing
his Belgian as well as his Rumanian nationalities.

MR. BEAUMONT'S "ENTERPRISES"

Following his arrival in Shanghai Mr. Beaumont
announced in local newspapers on July 1929 his intention
pages.zh:
(2)

被美国驱逐

某些“公共机构”对 Beaumont 先生的关注始于他于 1929 年 6 月 14 日从美国抵达上海之后。后来得知，Beaumont 是从加拿大维多利亚非法进入美国的。他于 1929 年 6 月抵达维多利亚，不久后越境进入美国，随即被拘留。随后他被驱逐至上海。

两次出生

授权将 Beaumont 从美国驱逐的第 55650-677 号令包含以下段落：

“1901 年 4 月 22 日出生于罗马尼亚布加勒斯特。
经华盛顿州布莱恩（Blaine）进入美国。
离境：1929 年 4 月 30 日，从英属加拿大维多利亚出发。”

据推测，关于 Beaumont 先生这一新出生地和新出生日期的信息取自后者提交的文件。

他出生在哪里？

如果情况属实，则该信息与这位未来工部局董事候选人原定的出生日期和地点相矛盾，差异涉及数个纬度和数年时间。

比利时罗马尼亚人还是罗马尼亚比利时人？

因此，既然 Beaumont 先生已在上海比利时领事馆注册，我们可以推测他持有证明其比利时国籍以及罗马尼亚国籍的出生证明和文件。

BEAUMONT 先生的“企业”

Beaumont 先生抵达上海后，于 1929 年 7 月在本地报纸上宣布其意图

pages.en:
(3)
to open a new "Golf Club" at Ying Ziang Kong. The club
was established but soon proved to be a financial failure
and the land occupied by the Club was sold at a public
auction.
Mr. Beaumont's next enterprise was the establishment
of a bicycle racing track. This new sport was inaugurated
at the "Speedway," Canidrome, Kiaochow Road. However,
the venture experienced similar financial difficulties and
was closed down in the beginning of 1930. While the
"Speedway" was still functioning, Beaumont became the
General Manager of an American Corporation known as
"Velodrome." After prolonged postponements the first
bicycle races and other kinds of entertainment took place
on Avenue Haig in April 1930, but in October of the same
year the enterprise was ruined owing to a civil suit for
the sum of $500.00 representing unpaid bills for advertising.
The Velodrome went out of existence and there are reasons
to believe that there are a number of accounts outstanding
in connection with this venture.
A PLUNGE IN INK!
Following the above experiences Mr. Beaumont devoted
himself to journalism and appeared in his present role of
the Editor of the "Spectator," which soon became the
medium for spreading"certain views.
In February 1933 he commenced the publishing of a
cheap newspaper entitled "The Daily Express" and later
also published a magazine entitled the "Sporting Life",
but both ventures shared the fate of the "Golf Club" and
the "Velodrome." Apart from the above enterprises
Beaumont has been connected with the "Studio d'Art",
Bubbling Well Road, as a sales agent on a commission basis.
pages.zh:
(3)
在引翔港开设一家新的“高尔夫俱乐部”。俱乐部虽已成立，但很快被证明在财务上是失败的，俱乐部所占土地被公开拍卖。
Beaumont 先生的下一个企业是建立一条自行车赛车跑道。这项新运动在胶州路的“速道”（Speedway），即逸园跑狗场（Canidrome）揭幕。然而，该企业遭遇了类似的财务困难，并于 1930 年初关闭。在“速道”仍在运营期间，Beaumont 成为了一家名为“Velodrome”的美国公司的总经理。经过长时间的拖延，第一次自行车比赛和其他娱乐活动于 1930 年 4 月在海格路举行，但同年 10 月，由于一起涉及 500.00 美元未付广告费的民事诉讼，该企业破产。Velodrome 不复存在，且有理由相信与该风险投资相关的账目仍有不少欠款。

投身报业！

经历上述事件后，Beaumont 先生投身新闻业，并以《观察家报》编辑的现任身份出现，该报很快成为传播“某些观点”的媒介。
1933 年 2 月，他开始出版一份名为《每日快报》（The Daily Express）的廉价报纸，后来又出版了一本名为《体育生活》（Sporting Life）的杂志，但这两项事业都遭遇了与“高尔夫俱乐部”和“Velodrome”相同的命运。除上述企业外，Beaumont 还与静安寺路的“艺术工作室”（Studio d'Art）有联系，担任佣金制销售代理。

pages.en:
(4)

DEBTS - THE MOST IMPORTANT FACTOR!

During all this time Beaumont was indebted to various persons and this circumstance explains his hostile attitude towards these persons and later inspired his articles in the "Spectator" on the subject of Shanghai money-lenders' evil. It is also not known whether or not Mr. Beaumont has paid the sum of $305.00 due for a gown for his wife bought from Mrs. L., a well known local dressmaker.

10 DAYS DETENTION

Recently Mr. Beaumont was sentenced by the local Belgian court to 10 days detention and fine for a libellous article published in the "Spectator" against Mr. Barbash, local merchant.

AND WHAT HAPPENED IN EUROPE?

Information at hand indicates that while in Europe Mr. Beaumont also came into conflict with certain laws.

VISITING DENS

Since the beginning of the last year Mr. Beaumont has been frequenting various places where gambling is conducted, a well known gambler acting as his guide.

BLOWS THAT MISSED THE TARGET

Some time during the last year a certain Russian employed with the Asia Realty Co. called at the Belgian Consulate and stated that he had inadvertently communicated to Mr. Beaumont certain facts regarding the company's activities, and that he had reasons to believe that these facts would be published in the "Spectator." Indeed, on June 22, 1933, an article was published in the journal referred to above, which aroused a strong protest on the part of the Asia Realty Co. However, according to the Belgian law, there were not sufficient grounds for instituting court proceedings against the Editor. Apparently this was the reason why in the following issue of the same journal another article on the same subject was published with the same result.
pages.zh:
(4)

债务——最重要的因素！

在此期间，Beaumont 欠下多人债务，这一情况解释了他对这些人的敌对态度，并后来促使他在《观察家报》上发表关于上海放贷者之恶的文章。此外，尚不清楚 Beaumont 先生是否支付了欠当地知名裁缝 L 夫人的 305.00 美元，那是为其妻子购买长袍的费用。

拘留 10 天

最近，Beaumont 先生因在《观察家报》上发表针对当地商人 Barbash 先生的诽谤文章，被当地比利时法庭判处拘留 10 天并处以罚款。

在欧洲发生了什么？

现有资料显示，Beaumont 先生在欧洲期间也曾与某些法律发生冲突。

光顾窝点

自去年初以来，Beaumont 先生频繁出入各种赌博场所，由一名知名赌徒充当向导。

未击中目标的打击

去年某段时间，一名受雇于亚洲地产公司（Asia Realty Co.）的俄国人前往比利时领事馆，称他无意中向 Beaumont 先生透露了有关该公司活动的一些事实，并有理由相信这些事实将在《观察家报》上刊登。确实，1933 年 6 月 22 日，上述期刊发表了一篇文章，引起了亚洲地产公司的强烈抗议。然而，根据比利时法律，没有足够的理由对编辑提起诉讼。显然，这就是为什么在该期刊的下一期中又发表了另一篇关于同一主题的文章，结果相同。

pages.en:
(8)

xxx xxx xxx

The above information contains the main data
regarding the respectable personality of Mr. Beaumont who
is prepared to consent to accept the most honourable post
- the post of a Councillor in the Shanghai Municipal
Council. He is warmly recommended by the "Shanghai Zaria."

The information does not include, for want of
space, Mr. Beaumont's activities covering the recent months,
during which period a series of slanderous articles were
published in the "Spectator" against the most prominent
workers of the now existing Municipal Council, who had
done so much for the Russian community.

This period of Mr. Beaumont's activities deserves
a special survey. We intend to publish the result of
this survey later on and at the same time we intend to
throw light on the participation in this affair of the
"Shanghai Zaria", an organ published in the Russian
language.

-----
pages.zh:
(8)

xxx xxx xxx

以上信息包含了这位准备同意接受最荣誉职位——上海工部局董事职位的 Beaumont 先生的人格主要资料。他受到《上海朝霞报》的热情推荐。

由于篇幅所限，这些信息未包括 Beaumont 先生最近几个月的活动，在此期间，《观察家报》发表了一系列诽谤文章，针对现任工部局中最杰出的工作人员，他们为俄国侨民社区做了很多工作。

Beaumont 先生这一时期的活动值得特别审视。我们打算稍后公布此次审查的结果，同时我们也打算阐明俄语刊物《上海朝霞报》在此事中的参与情况。

-----

pages.en:
TRANSLATIONS FROM CHINESE

In the Second Special District Court, Shanghai.

Private Criminal Prosecution

A. W. Beaumont, Complainant,
Aged 37, Belgian, Editor of "Spectator" 15 museum rd.
Represented by Attorneys Kiang Yih Bing and Li Kung Sian
versus
B. A. Chilikin, Accused, Russian.
----------------------------------------

Complaint

For malicious libel being committed and for cause to be
dealt with according to law, the complainant alleges :

The members of the Shanghai Municipal Council will be
elected on March 10th and/or the latter part of the month from
the Foreign Ratepayers Association, and the complainant being
a merchant at Shanghai with suitable biography has been nominated
as one of the candidates. Unexpectedly on February 7, of the
present year, the accused, published a biography of the com-
plainant, in the Russian paper called" Kapeika" of which the
accused is the editor, and the facts therein stated are all
falsely manufactured and ridiculous which are sufficient to
attack the personal character of the complainant. A copy of
the said Russian Paper together with the translations are
herewith filed.

Complainant prays for trial according to law, and charges
the accused for the offense according to Article 325 of the
Criminal Law.

Shanghai, Feb. 24, 1934.
pages.zh:
中文译文

上海第二特区法院。

刑事自诉案件

原告 A. W. Beaumont，
37 岁，比利时人，《观察家报》编辑，住址博物馆路 15 号。
由律师蒋义炳和李公贤代理
诉
被告 B. A. Chilikin，俄国人。
----------------------------------------

诉状

就恶意诽谤罪行及依法处理之事由，原告指控如下：

上海工部局董事将于 3 月 10 日及/或本月下旬从外国纳税人协会中选举产生，原告作为在上海经商且履历合适之人，已被提名为候选人之一。不料于今年 2 月 7 日，被告在其担任编辑的俄文报纸《戈佩卡报》（Kapeika）上刊登了原告的传记，其中所述事实均为捏造且荒谬，足以攻击原告的个人品格。随函附上该俄文报纸副本及译文。

原告请求依法审判，并根据刑法第 325 条指控被告犯有此罪。

上海，1934 年 2 月 24 日。

pages.en:
Translation from the Russian newspaper
"Kopeika" of February 7,1934.
----------------------------------------
The "Well-wisher" or "Benefactor" of the
Russian Community in Shanghai.
Beaumont and his amusing attempt to occupy the
Chair of Adviser to the S. M. C.

In the Autumn of last year an indisputable 'business"
contact was established to all appearances between two, although
seemingly different press organs i.e. the Russian newspaper
"Shanghai Zarya" and the weekly periodical published in
English and entitled "The Shanghai Spectator", the editor
and publisher of which is a certain Mr. Beaumont.
Readers will remember with what enthusiasm the Shanghai
Zarya reproduced a long article from that periodical entitled
"Russians, hold your heads higher up" in which the Russians
were being patted on the shoulder with much approval by
Mr. Beaumont who deigned to stoop down to them.
The Shanghai Zarya in addition to the reproduction of
the article in question, added its own comments whereby
Russians were mainly been given the explanation how much
they had gained having attracted the attention of Mr. Beaumont.
All that was rather mysterious and at the time pretty
difficult to understand for what reasons and purposes Mr.
Beaumont was undertaking the part of a benefactor for the
Russian residents of Shanghai.
In an equal measure the unexpected alliance of the
Shanghai Zarya with the little known to most Russians
"Spectator", which up to that time was being published for
other circles and other purposes, could not be understood.
However, a short time ago, the attitude of this
publication became definitely that of attracting Russian
readers, in proof of which a similar publication was issued
in Russian on two occasions. It is not our aim here to
comment on the Russian issue of the "Spectator".

7
pages.zh:
译自 1934 年 2 月 7 日俄文报纸
《戈佩卡报》（Kopeika）。
----------------------------------------
上海俄国侨民的“好心人”或“恩人”。
Beaumont 及其竞选工部局顾问席位的滑稽尝试。

去年秋天，两家看似不同的新闻机构之间显然建立了无可争议的“商业”联系，即俄文报纸《上海朝霞报》和英文周刊《上海观察家报》，后者的编辑和出版人是某位 Beaumont 先生。
读者们一定记得，《上海朝霞报》曾热情地转载了该周刊的一篇长文，题为《俄国人，抬起头来》，文中 Beaumont 先生屈尊俯就，对俄国人给予了极大的赞许和拍肩鼓励。
《上海朝霞报》除了转载该文章外，还添加了自己的评论，主要向俄国人解释他们因引起 Beaumont 先生的注意而获得了多少利益。
这一切都相当神秘，当时很难理解 Beaumont 先生出于何种原因和目的扮演上海俄国居民恩人的角色。
同样令人不解的是，《上海朝霞报》与大多数俄国人不太熟悉的《观察家报》之间出乎意料的联盟，后者在此之前一直是为其他圈子和目的出版的。
然而，不久前，该刊物的态度明确转变为吸引俄国读者，为此曾两次出版俄文版作为证明。此处我们的目的并非评论《观察家报》的俄文版。

7

pages.en:
- 2 -

Just at present we are interested in the latest
facts, proving the existence of a united policy between
the "Shanghai Zarya"and the "Spectator" namely:
Only in yesterday's issue of the "Shanghai Zarya"
an article entitled "The statement of the Group "In favour
of Shanghai", was published, beginning with the significant
paragraph reading as follows:-
"In the latest issue of the "Shanghai
Spectator" in English, A.B. Beaumont,
the Editor and Publisher, dedicates an
articles to the question as to conditions
on which he would agree to put forward
his name as a candidate to the post of
Adviser on the future Board of Councillors
of the Shanghai Municipal Council. "
Thus, the syndicate of the "Shanghai Zarya" and the
"Spectator" have revealed them selves and have openly
declared their political belief affecting public interests.
No more room is now left for surmises and indefinite
attempts at guessing what is it all about.. The purpose
of this alliance is now clear to everyone; it consisted
of acquainting the public with the conditions under which
Mr. Beaumont "would agree" to serve as a Councillor in
the International Settlement Council, at future elections.
Mr. Beaumont is dictating these conditions on the
pages of his publication.
The Shanghai Zarya draws the attention of Russian
readers to these conditions on the pages of its own
publication.
The post of Councillor in the Municipal Council is a
very important post.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

目前我们关注的是最新事实，这些事实证明了《上海霞报》（Shanghai Zarya）与《观察家报》（Spectator）之间存在统一的政策，即：
仅在昨日出版的《上海霞报》上，刊登了一篇题为《“拥护上海”团体的声明》的文章，其开篇段落意味深长，内容如下：——
“在最新一期的英文《上海观察家报》中，编辑兼出版人 A.B. 博蒙特（A.B. Beaumont） dedicating 一篇文章，探讨他同意提名为上海工部局未来董事会顾问候选人的条件。”
因此，《上海霞报》与《观察家报》的联营集团已自我暴露，并公开宣布了影响公共利益的他们的政治信仰。现在已不再留有猜测和模糊推断的空间。这一联盟的目的现已对所有人清晰可见；其目的在于让公众知晓博蒙特先生在未来选举中“同意”担任国际租界工部局董事的条件。
博蒙特先生正在其出版物的版面上 dictate 这些条件。
《上海霞报》在其版面上提请俄国读者注意这些条件。
工部局董事一职是非常重要的职位。

pages.en:
- 3 -

At least, up to the present the candidates put
up for this post were selected out of the permanent
residents of Shanghai, who were noted for remarkable
and outstanding merits in the local public affairs.
During the whole time of existence of Shanghai
there was no occasion as yet when any of the candidates
proposed were subjected to the least doubt of having
a right to holding the post.
Shanghai has not seen yet a candidate to the Municipal
Councillors, who would be supporting his candidature
with his own voice, being at the same time not only an
unknown person, but even a suspicious one for the rest
of the population.
Mr. Beaumont, having begun to discuss the conditions,
all to himself, under which he would make Shanghai happy
by occupying the chair of Adviser to the Municipal Council,
appears to us to be a phenomena of the kind which not only
the Council but even the local Museum has not possessed yet!
From now on Mr. Beaumont deserves in addition to close
attention, a complete description of his personality.
The population of Shanghai has every reason now to
know everything about this new, as well as unexpected
candidate to the Shanghai Municipal Council. There must
be no secrets here. Therefore, whilst Mr. Beaumont is
engaged in debating with himself about the conditions
proposed by him, the population of Shanghai has a right
to proceed to the studying of his biography.
In pursuance of the above, in our to-morrow's issue
data concerning Mr. Beaumont will be published, which
will enable the population of Shanghai to draw conclusions
of their own as to his characteristics, prior to inviting
him to occupy the seat of Adviser to the Shanghai Municipal
Council.
pages.zh:
- 3 -

至少到目前为止，被推举担任此职的候选人都是从上海的常住居民中选拔出来的，他们在地方公共事务中以显著和杰出的功绩而闻名。
在上海存在的整个时期内，尚未出现过任何被提名的候选人对其任职权利产生丝毫怀疑的情况。
上海尚未见过这样的工部局董事候选人：不仅是一个无名之辈，甚至对其余居民来说还是一个可疑人物，却用自己的声音支持自己的候选资格。
博蒙特先生开始独自讨论他若占据工部局顾问席位将使上海幸福的那些条件，在我们看来，这不仅是工部局、甚至是本地博物馆都未曾有过的现象！
从现在起，博蒙特先生除了受到密切关注外，还值得对其人格进行完整的描述。
上海居民现在有充分的理由了解这位新的、也是出乎意料的上海工部局董事候选人的所有情况。这里不应有任何秘密。因此，当博蒙特先生忙于与自己辩论他所提出的条件时，上海居民有权着手研究他的生平传记。
鉴于上述情况，在我报明日的版面上将刊登有关博蒙特先生的资料，以便上海居民在邀请他担任上海工部局顾问席位之前，能够自行对其特征得出结论。

Special Branch - S.2.
June 30, 1933.

Memorandum on A.W. Beaumont.

Adolphe Weisman Beaumont whose real name is Adolphe
Israelowicz, was born at Antwerp, Belgium on March 4, 1897
of Polish parents. His father's name (deceased) was Maurice
Israelowicz and his mother's maiden name is Tauber. She is
still residing in Belgium. These facts have been confirmed
by the Belgian home authorities.

Beaumont claims to be a naturalised American subject but
he is not recognised by the local American Consul-General. He
has however, been registered at the local Belgian Consulate-
General since February 20, 1930, and moreover holds a Belgian
passport.

Beaumont first came to the notice of the Shanghai
Municipal Police following his arrival in this city on June 14,
1929 after being deported from America. It appears that in
June 1928 Beaumont arrived in Victoria, B.C. and shortly
afterwards crossed the border into the United States where
he was later apprehended and deported for illegal entry.
In this connection it is of interest to note that the
American Warrant of Deportation No.55650-677 issued against
Beaumont bears the following particulars :

"Born April 22, 1901, at Bukharest, Rumania.
Last arrival in U.S.A. at Blaine, Washington.
Departure - April 30, 1929 from Victoria B.C."

It is presumed that the particulars regarding Beaumont's
place and date of birth were taken by the American authorities
at the time of his apprehension prior to his deportation, from
documents then in his possession. These particulars, it will
be seen, are totally different from those known to the local

关于 A.W. 博蒙特的备忘录。

阿道夫·韦斯曼·博蒙特，其真名为阿道夫·伊斯雷洛维奇，1897年3月4日出生于比利时安特卫普，父母为波兰人。其父（已故）名为莫里斯·伊斯雷洛维奇，其母婚前姓陶伯（Tauber）。她仍居住在比利时。这些事实已由比利时国内当局证实。

博蒙特声称自己是归化美国公民，但未得到当地美国总领事馆的认可。然而，他自1930年2月20日起已在当地比利时总领事馆注册，并持有比利时护照。

博蒙特首次引起上海公共租界工部局警务处注意，是在他于1929年6月14日被美国驱逐出境后抵达本市之时。据悉，博蒙特于1928年6月抵达不列颠哥伦比亚省维多利亚市，随后不久越境进入美国，后因非法入境被捕并被驱逐出境。
在此方面，值得注意的是，针对博蒙特签发的美国驱逐令第55650-677号载有以下详情：

“1901年4月22日出生于罗马尼亚布加勒斯特。
最后一次抵达美国地点为华盛顿州布莱恩。
离境 - 1929年4月30日从不列颠哥伦比亚省维多利亚市出发。”

据推测，关于博蒙特出生地和日期的详情是美国当局在他被驱逐前逮捕他时，从他当时持有的文件中获取的。可以看出，这些详情与当地

Belgian Consulate authorities, so there is a possibility of
Beaumont having had, or still being in possession of, papers
of two different nationalities.

In July 1929 Beaumont announced in the local press that
he intended to open a new Golf Club at Ying Hsiang Kong.
Allied with him in this venture was one H.D. Rodger, an
American, a lawyer by profession. The Riverview Golf Club
came into existence, but proved a financial failure and the
ground that it then occupied has since been offered for sale.
Beaumont next interested himself in the promotion of a motor-
cycle race track. The introduction of this new sport to the
Shanghai public at the "Speedway" in the grounds of the Stadium
Greyhound Racecourse, Kiaochow Road, now defunct. Like his
previous venture, this concern was soon in financial difficulties
and was compelled to close at the beginning of 1930. Whilst
the "Speedway" was still in operation Beaumont became managing
director of an American registered corporation known as
"Velodrome" Inc. After many delays this concern opened a
cycle racing and amusement resort on Avenue Haig in April 1930,
but by October of the same year he was sued in the American
Court by the International Advertising Agency for $500.00 when
judgment was rendered against the defendant. Soon after, the
"Velodrome" ceased to exist as an amusement resort and it is
believed that there were a great number of accounts still
unsettled when the company terminated its activities.

Beaumont next appeared as the editor of the "Spectator" -
a semi-sporting and social paper of distinct scurrilous
tendencies - which made its initial appearance during 1931.
On February 27, 1932 he launched a cheap midday publication
called the "Daily Express" from his office at 3 Museum Road,
which however, flourished for only a few days. He is also
believed to have been responsible for the publication of a

比利时领事当局所知的情况完全不同，因此博蒙特可能曾经拥有，或者仍然拥有两种不同国籍的文件。

1929年7月，博蒙特在当地报刊上宣布，他打算在引翔港开设一家新的高尔夫俱乐部。与他共同从事这项事业的是一个名叫 H.D. 罗杰（H.D. Rodger）的美国人，职业为律师。里维尤高尔夫俱乐部（Riverview Golf Club）随之成立，但证明在财务上是失败的，其所占用的土地此后已被出售。
博蒙特接下来热衷于推广摩托车赛道。这项新运动通过位于胶州路跑狗场体育场内的“Speedway”引入上海公众视野，该场地现已废弃。与他之前的 venture 一样，该企业很快陷入财务困境，并被迫于1930年初关闭。在“Speedway”仍在运营期间，博蒙特成为了一家在美国注册的名为“Velodrome” Inc. 的公司的总经理。经过多次延误，该企业于1930年4月在爱文义路（Avenue Haig）开设了一个自行车赛车和娱乐场所，但同年10月，国际广告代理商在美国法院起诉他索赔500.00美元，判决被告败诉。不久之后，“Velodrome”作为娱乐场所不复存在，据信该公司终止活动时仍有大量账目未结清。

博蒙特随后以《观察家报》编辑的身份出现——这是一份具有明显诽谤倾向的半体育半社交报纸——该报于1931年首次发行。
1932年2月27日，他在博物馆路3号的办公室推出了一份廉价的午间出版物，名为《每日快报》（Daily Express），但该报仅维持了几天便告失败。据信他还负责出版了一份

pages.en:

form r periodical - "Sporting Life."

Ever since its inception some two years ago Beaumont
has been connected with the Studio d'Art, 126 Bubbling Well
Road. Beaumont was very active in having this company
registered with the United States Consulate-General, but is
not, as he pretends to be, actually on the Board of Directors.
The real own.r of this company is one Chang who resides at
House No.2, Passage No.54 Route Paul Henri and Beaumont
receives a commission on all business which he is able to
introduce to the firm.

It is believed that he owes money to various business
concerns in Shanghai, and in April 1932 it was known for a
fact that he owed $305 to Mrs. E. Lipkovsky, wife of the
Siberian Jewellery Store Proprietor, for dresses supplied
in the early months of 1932 to the alleged Mrs. Beaumont,
with whom he was then residing at Flat 62, Hotel Monchen,
Bubbling Well Road.

In October or November of 1932 Beaumont was convicted
at the local Belgian Consulate-General in an action for
defamation of character brought by one B.S. Barbash, a
Russian moneylender, of 467 Kiangse Road, and was sentenced
to 10 days imprisonment, which was later commuted to a fine,
as it is against the policy of the Belgian authorities to
enforce prison sentences save in very serious cases. The
fine was paid.

He was also convicted by default for fraud some years
ago in Paris. (N.B. This statement has been confirmed by the
local French authorities, who add that no attempt has even
been made to extradite Beaumont)

Information from a reliable source indicated that
several complaints had been made against this individual
regarding the non-payments of debts. In this connection the

定期刊物——《体育生活》（Sporting Life）。

自大约两年前成立以来，博蒙特一直与静安寺路126号的 Studio d'Art 有关联。博蒙特非常积极地将该公司在美国总领事馆注册，但他实际上并不像他自称的那样是董事会成员。该公司的真正所有者是一个姓张的人，住在保罗亨利路54弄2号，博蒙特从他为该公司介绍的所有业务中收取佣金。

据信他欠上海多家商号款项，且在1932年4月，确切已知他欠西伯利亚珠宝店店主之妻 E. 利普科夫斯基夫人305美元，用于支付1932年初提供给所谓博蒙特夫人的服装，当时他与该女子同居于静安寺路蒙臣公寓62室。

1932年10月或11月，博蒙特在当地比利时总领事馆因一名居住在江西路467号的俄国放债人 B.S. 巴巴什（B.S. Barbash）提起的名誉诽谤诉讼中被判有罪，并被判处监禁10天，后改为罚款，因为除非在非常严重的案件中，否则执行监禁判决不符合比利时当局的政策。罚款已支付。

几年前，他还在巴黎因欺诈罪被缺席定罪。（注：此陈述已由当地法国当局证实，他们补充说，甚至未尝试引渡博蒙特）

来自可靠来源的信息表明，已有多起针对此人拖欠债务的投诉。在此方面，

pages.en:
- 4 -

Belgian authorities summoned Beaumont to the Consulate for
purposes of questioning and admonition. Beaumont promised
to pay off his debtors at the rate of $40 per month.

In early January 1933 it became known that Beaumont was
an acquaintance of one "Jimmy" Llado, a notorious gambler
and conductor of various gambling dens throughout the
Settlement and the French Concession. Beaumont was seen to
visit the Pacific Club, 56a Hart Road, several times during
January of this year.

A week or so ago, a certain Russian who alleged that
he formerly was an employee of the Asia Realty Co., visited
the Belgian Consulate-General and said that he had revealed
to Beaumont certain facts about the company, and that he
feared that Beaumont was going to use them in an article in
the "Spectator". Summoned to the Consulate for interrogation
about this report, Beaumont admitted that he had prepared
such an article, but stated that before publishing it he would
obtain Dr. Sellett's approval, as he did not wish to offend
American susceptibilities. The statements he had made about
the Asia Realty Co. were true, he stated, and after Dr.Sellett
had seen the article, he (the latter) saw no objection to it.

The article in question was published in the "Spectator"
dated June 22, 1933, and according to information received was
greatly objected to by the company. The article however, being
true, does not constitute libel under Belgian law. A further
article regarding the activities of the Asia Realty Company
was published in an issue of the "Spectator" dated June 29,1933.

According to reliable information Beaumont's lawyer is
Auxion de Ruffe, but he sometimes seeks advice from Paul
Faison of Messrs Fessenden and Holcomb.

Beaumont is at present residing at Apartment 6,
I.S.S. Apartments, 1552 Avenue Joffre.
pages.zh:
- 4 -

比利时当局传唤博蒙特到领事馆进行讯问和训诫。博蒙特承诺以每月40美元的速率偿还债权人。

1933年1月初，获悉博蒙特是“吉米”·利亚多（"Jimmy" Llado）的熟人，后者是一名臭名昭著的赌徒，并在整个租界和法租界经营多家赌场。今年1月期间，有人多次看到博蒙特访问哈特路56a号的太平洋俱乐部。

大约一周前，一名自称曾是亚洲地产公司员工的俄国人访问了比利时总领事馆，称他向博蒙特透露了关于该公司的一些事实，并且他担心博蒙特会在《观察家报》的一篇文章中使用这些事实。博蒙特被传唤到领事馆就这一报告进行讯问，他承认已准备了这样一篇文章，但表示在发表之前他会获得塞莱特博士（Dr. Sellett）的批准，因为他不想冒犯美国人的情感。他表示，他对亚洲地产公司所做的陈述是真实的，并且在塞莱特博士看过这篇文章后，后者表示没有异议。

相关文章刊登在1933年6月22日的《观察家报》上，据收到的信息，该公司对此强烈反对。然而，由于文章内容属实，根据比利时法律不构成诽谤。另一篇关于亚洲地产公司活动的文章刊登在1933年6月29日的《观察家报》上。

据可靠消息，博蒙特的律师是奥克雄·德·鲁夫（Auxion de Ruffe），但他有时也向费森登和霍尔科姆律师事务所的保罗·费森（Paul Faison）寻求建议。

博蒙特目前居住于霞飞路1552号 I.S.S. 公寓6室。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

File No. C. 3307
Section 2. Station,
Date December 28th 1932

Subject (in full) A.W. Beaumont, owner of the Shanghai Spectator.

Made by D.S. Prokofiev Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the memo of the Officer i/c Special Branch dated November 11, 1932, on the subject of A.W. Beaumont, enquiries made with a view to tracing this individual's career previous to 1929 elicited the following information:-

On May 31, 1928 he registered with the Bureau of Foreign Affairs for "iangsu,"o I Chiao Lao Road, giving the following particulars:-

"A.ilsman Beaumont, Rumanian, born April 22, 1903, at Bukarest, single, merchant; arrived in Shanghai from Bukarest in 1928." (Reg. No 171 ).

On June 1, 1928 he applied at the Bureau of Foreign Affairs for passport facilities to enable him to proceed to Rumania. Foreign passport No 143 valid for six months was issued to him on the same date.

On June 2, 1928 he left Shanghai for Victoria, B.C., on board the S.S. "Empress of Asia". When booking the passage at the local office of the Canadian Pacific Railway Co he gave his profession as that of watchmaker and his address in Shanghai as c/o Mr. Paul Premet, No 6 French Bund.

Enquiries have failed to ascertain when and from where Beaumont first arrived in Shanghai. However, from the statement made by Sgt L. Jones, 2-nd Batallion, 31st United States Infantry ( vide page 3 of the attached memorandum) it appears that Beaumont was in Manila in 1927-28 and that he left that city bound for Shanghai about March 1928.

Attached herewith are three copies of A.W. Beaumont's photograph.

G. Prokofiev
D.S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

1928年5月31日，他在外侨事务处登记住址为“江苏”o I Chiao Lao Road（原文不清），并提供以下详情：-

“Ailsman Beaumont，罗马尼亚人，1903年4月22日出生于布加勒斯特，未婚，商人；1928年从布加勒斯特抵达上海。”（登记号 171）。

1928年6月1日，他向外侨事务处申请护照便利，以便前往罗马尼亚。同日向其签发了有效期为六个月的外国护照第143号。

1928年6月2日，他乘坐“亚细亚皇后”号轮船（S.S. "Empress of Asia"）离开上海前往不列颠哥伦比亚省维多利亚市。在加拿大太平洋铁路公司本地办事处预订船票时，他申报的职业为钟表匠，在沪地址为法租界外滩6号 Paul Premet 先生转交。

Memorandum on A.W. Beaumont.

Adolph Weisman Beaumont alias Israelevitch is
believed to have been born in Antwerp, Belgium on March
4, 1897. He claims to be a naturalised American citizen but
is not recognized by the local American Consul-General He has
however been registered with the local Belgian Consulate-
General since February 20, 1930.

Beaumont first came to the notice of the Shanghai
Municipal Police following his arrival in this city on
June 14, 1929 after being deported from America. It appears
that in June 1928 Beaumont arrived in Victoria, British Columbia
and shortly afterwards crossed over the border into the
United States where he was later apprehended and deported for
illegal entry. In this connection it is interesting to note
that the American Warrant of Deportation No.55650-677
issued against Beaumont bears the following particulars :-
Born April 22, 1901, at Bukharest, Rumania, Last arrival
in U.S.A. at Blaine, Washington, Departure, April 30, 1929
from Victoria B.C. It is presumed that the particulars concerning the place and date of Beaumont's birth were taken by the
American Authorities at the time of his apprehension prior to
deportation, from documents then in his possession. These
particulars it will be seen are contrary to those known to
the local Belgian Consular Authorities so there is a
possibility of Beaumont having had or still being in possession
of papers of two different nationalities.

he intended to open a new Golf Club at Ying Hsiang Kong.

lawyer by profession. The Riverview Golf Club came into

X Following the recent advent of the 31st United
States Infantry to Shanghai, Beaumont was recognized by
Sgt. L. Jones, 2nd Battalion of that organization, as a
man he had known in Manila in 1927-28. According to Jones,
Beaumont was at that time owner of a bar known as Boots
Cafe situated at the corner of Cal Victoria and Gala Luna
which he ran in co-operation with a woman alleged to be his
wife. Beaumont was believed to have been concerned in
several shady deals and about March 1928 hurriedly and
secretly left Manila to escape interrogation by the
Manila Police concerning various worthless cheques he had
issued. Jones states that he afterwards discovered Beaumont had

in June 1929. Sgt. Jones contemplates taking civil

Memorandum on A. W. Beaumont.

Adolph Weisman Beaumont alias Israelevitch
is believed to have been born in Antwerp Belgium on
March 4, 1897. He claims to be a naturalized American
citizen but is not recognised by the local American
Consul-General. He has however, been registered
with the local Belgian Consulate-General since
February 20, 1930.

Beaumont first came to the notice of the Shanghai
Municipal Police following his arrival in this city
on June 14, 1929 after being deported from America.
It appears that in June 1928 Beaumont arrived in
Victoria, British Columbia and shortly afterwards
crossed over the border into the United States where
he was later apprehended and deported for illegal
entry. In this connection it is interesting to note
that the American Warrant of Deportation No.55650-677
issued against Beaumont bears the following particulars:-
**Born, April 22, 1901 at Bukharest, Rumania, Last arrival**
**in U.S.A. at Blaine, Washington, Departure, April 30,**
**1929 from Victoria B.C.** It is presumed that the
particulars concerning the place and date of Beaumont's
birth were taken by the American Authorities at the time
of his apprehension prior to deportation, from documents
then in his possession. These particulars it will be
seen are contrary to those known to the local Belgian
Consular Authorities, so there is a possibility of
Beaumont having had or still being in possession of
papers of two different nationalities.

关于 A. W. Beaumont 的备忘录。

Adolph Weisman Beaumont，别名 Israelevitch，
据信于1897年3月4日出生于比利时安特卫普。他声称自己是归化美国公民，但未得到当地美国总领事馆的认可。不过，他自1930年2月20日起已在当地比利时总领事馆注册。

Beaumont 在1929年6月14日被美国驱逐出境后抵达本市，从而首次引起上海公共租界工部局警务处的注意。看来，Beaumont 于1928年6月抵达不列颠哥伦比亚省维多利亚市，不久后越境进入美国，随后因非法入境被捕并被驱逐出境。在此方面，值得注意的是，针对 Beaumont 签发的美国驱逐令第55650-677号载有以下详情：-
**1901年4月22日出生于罗马尼亚布加勒斯特，最后一次抵达**
**美国地点为华盛顿州布莱恩（Blaine），1929年4月30日**
**从不列颠哥伦比亚省维多利亚市离境。** 据推测，
有关 Beaumont 出生地点和日期的详情，是美国当局
在驱逐前逮捕他时，从他当时持有的文件中获取的。
可以看出，这些详情与当地比利时
领事当局所知的情况相矛盾，因此
Beaumont 可能曾经持有或目前仍持有
两种不同国籍的文件。

In July 1929, Beaumont announced in the local
press that he intended to open a new Golf Club at
Ting Hsien: Kong. Connected with him in this
venture was one H.D. Rodger a lawyer by profession.
The Riverview Golf Club came into being but proved a
financial failure and the ground it occupies has since
been offered for sale. Beaumont next interested him-
self in the promotion of a motor-cycle race track.
The introduction of this sport to the Shanghai public
took place at the "Speedway" in the grounds of the
Stadium Greyhound Racecourse, Kiachow Road. Like
his previous venture, this concern was soon in financial
difficulties and was compelled to close at the beginning
of 1930. Whilst the "Speedway" was still in operation
Beaumont became managing director of an American registered
corporation known as the "Velodrome" Inc. After many
delays this concern opened a cycle racing and amusement
resort on Avenue Haig in April 1930, but by October of the
same year was sued in the American Court by the Inter-
national Advertising Corporation for $500 when judgment
was delivered against the defendants. Soon after the
"Velodrome" ceased to exist as an amusement resort and
it is understood that there are still several accounts
outstanding. In these ventures one H.E. Booker, general
manager of the Far Eastern Theatre Co. Arnhold Building,
6 Kiukiang Road has been closely connected with Beaumont.
Beaumont next appeared in the guise of editor of the
"Spectator" a semi-sporting and social publication which
made its appearance in 1931 and on February 27, 1932
launched a cheap mid-day publication called the "Daily
Express" from his office at 3 Museum Road, which only

ONLY those who have paid

of the Riverview Golf Club,
realize what a tremendous lot

paratively short space of time.
The Course which lies op-

just beyond the Point, should

particularly those who are not

Since the inaugural meeting held

The General Committee, now

ship to the Club will take charge
