No. 80 Nanling Road, it having removed during this
year from No. 15 Museum Road to No. 126 Bubbling
Well Road and from the latter address to its present
venue.

With reference to the various paragraphs
of this memorandum which indicate Beaumont's pen-
chant for issuing cheques without provision for
meeting them, the following is a translation from
Article 509 bis of the Belgian Penal Code ( Law
of March 25, 1929, Article 1):-

"A penalty of one month to two years
"imprisonment and a fine of from Fcs.25
"to Fcs.3000 shall be imposed on:
"1) any person who knowingly issues
"without sufficient provision (funds)
"available in advance, a cheque or any
"other document as payment in cash and
"at sight on available funds.
"2) any person who parts with one of
"these documents knowing that the
"funds are insufficient and are not
"available.
"3) The drawer who knowingly withdraws
"the whole or part of the funds of one
"of these documents, within three months
"of its issue.
"4) The drawer who, with fraudulent intent
"or with the purpose of producing, renders
"unavailable, all or a part of the funds
"of one of these documents."

关于本备忘录中表明 Beaumont 倾向于签发空头支票的各段落，以下是《比利时刑法典》第 509 条之二（1929 年 3 月 25 日法律，第一条）的译文：

“应判处一个月至两年监禁，
“并处 25 法郎至 3000 法郎罚款，对象为：

pages.en:
MEMORANDUM ON A.W. BEAUMONT

Adolphe Weisman Beaumont whose real name is
Adolphe Israelowicz, was born at Antwerp, Belgium, of
Polish parents on March 4, 1897. His father, now
deceased, was Maurice Israelowicz and his mother, whose
maiden name was Tauber, is still residing in Belgium.

Beaumont has been registered at the local
Belgian Consulate-General under the name of Israelowicz
since February 20, 1930 and moreover is the possessor
of a Belgian passport which bears the inscription
"Israelowicz dit Beaumont." (Israelowicz alias Beaumont).

Beaumont first came to the notice of the
Shanghai Municipal Police following his arrival in
Shanghai on June 14, 1939 by the s.s. "Empress of Russia."
It appears that in June 1928 Beaumont arrived in
Victoria, B.C. and shortly afterwards crossed the Canadian
border into the United States, where a few weeks later
he was detected, apprehended, and deported on the ground
of illegal entry. In this connection it is of interest
to note that the American Warrant of Deportation
No. 5660-677 issued against Beaumont bears the following
particulars:

"Born April 22, 1901 at Bucharest, Rumania.
"Last arrival in U.S.A. at Blaine, Washington.
"Departure - April 30, 1929 from Victoria, B.C."

In July 1929, Beaumont announced to the Shanghai
public through the local press that he intended opening
a new golf club at Ying Hsiung Kang. The Riverview
Golf Club came into existence shortly after Beaumont's
announcement, but proved a financial failure. Beaumont
next interested himself in the promotion of a motor-cycle
race track called "Speedway" which was constructed in
the site on Kiaocheo Road subsequently used for Greyhound
Racing under the name of "The Stadium." The "Speedway"
was soon in financial difficulties and closed down at
the beginning of 1930. Whilst the "Speedway" was still
pages.zh:
关于 A.W. BEAUMONT 的备忘录

Adolphe Weisman Beaumont，真名为 Adolphe Israelowicz，1897 年 3 月 4 日出生于比利时安特卫普，父母均为波兰人。其父 Maurice Israelowicz 已故，其母娘家姓 Tauber，现仍居住在比利时。

自 1930 年 2 月 20 日起，Beaumont 即以 Israelowicz 之名在当地比利时总领事馆登记，此外，他持有一本比利时护照，上面注明“Israelowicz dit Beaumont.”（Israelowicz，又名 Beaumont）。

Beaumont 首次引起上海公共租界警务处注意是在他于 1939 年 6 月 14 日乘“俄罗斯皇后”号轮船抵达上海之后。（注：此处原文年份似有误，结合下文应为 1928 或 1929 年左右，但依要求照实译出）。看来，Beaumont 于 1928 年 6 月抵达不列颠哥伦比亚省维多利亚市，不久后越过加拿大边境进入美国，几周后因非法入境被发现、逮捕并驱逐出境。对此值得注意的是，针对 Beaumont 签发的美国驱逐令第 5660-677 号载有以下详情：

“1901 年 4 月 22 日出生于罗马尼亚布加勒斯特。
“最后一次抵达美国地点为华盛顿州布莱恩。
“离境 - 1929 年 4 月 30 日，从不列颠哥伦比亚省维多利亚市。”

1929 年 7 月，Beaumont 通过当地媒体向上海公众宣布，他打算在英雄港开设一家新的高尔夫俱乐部。Riverview Golf Club 在 Beaumont 宣布后不久成立，但证明在财务上是失败的。接着，Beaumont 致力于推广一个名为“Speedway”的摩托车赛道，该赛道建在胶州路的一处场地上，该场地后来以“The Stadium”为名用于赛狗。“Speedway”很快陷入财务困境，并于 1930 年初关闭。当“Speedway”仍在

pages.en:
- 2 -

in operation Beaumont became managing-director of an
American registered corporation known as "Velodrome Inc."
After many delays this concern opened a cycle racing
and amusement resort on Avenue Haig in April 1930, but
closed down in a state of bankruptcy about the end of
the year.

During 1931 Beaumont became editor of the
"Shanghai Spectator," a semi-sporting and social paper
of scurrilous tendencies. On February 27, 1932 - during
the local Sino-Japanese hostilities - he launched a
cheap midday publication termed the "Daily Express" from
an office at No. 3 Museum Road. The "Daily Express"
closed down after a brief existence. Beaumont is also
believed to have been responsible for the publication of
a periodical of the mushroom type entitled "Sporting Life."

In October or November of 1932 Beaumont was
convicted at the local Belgian Court in an action for
defamation of character brought by a Russian money-lender
named B.S. Barbash, No. 467 Kiangsu Road, and was sentenced
to ten (10) days' imprisonment, but the sentence was later
commuted to a fine which was paid.

In January 1933 it became known that Beaumont
was an acquaintance of "Jimmy" Llado, a person of doubtful
reputation. On January 31, 1933 the French Police
found Beaumont in a gambling house at No. 805 Avenue Foch,
but did not prosecute him.

In the "Spectator" of September 21, 1933 an
article over the name of A.W. Beaumont entitled "Shanghai
White Slave Traffic Exposed" attracted considerable attention
to that journal. This story depicted Shanghai as a city
where vice was openly practised, where white women were
bought and sold without hindrance, and where ruthless
white women enriched themselves through the pitiless
exploitation of their less fortunate sisters. Tolerance
pages.zh:
- 2 -

在运营期间，博蒙特（Beaumont）成为一家名为“Velodrome Inc.”的美国注册公司的董事总经理。经过多次延误，该企业于1930年4月在爱文义路（Avenue Haig）开设了一家自行车赛车及娱乐度假村，但在年底前后以破产状态关闭。

1931年间，博蒙特成为《上海观察家报》（Shanghai Spectator）的编辑，这是一份带有明显诽谤倾向的半体育、半社交类报纸。1932年2月27日——正值当地中日冲突期间——他在博物馆路3号的一间办公室内推出了一份名为《每日快报》（Daily Express）的廉价午间出版物。《每日快报》在短暂存在后便停刊。据信，博蒙特还负责出版了一份名为《体育生活》（Sporting Life）的昙花一现式的期刊。

1932年10月或11月，博蒙特在当地比利时法院因一名居住在江苏路467号、名为B.S. Barbash的俄罗斯放债人提起的名誉诽谤诉讼中被判有罪，并被判处十（10）天监禁，但该判决后来减为罚款，且罚款已缴纳。

1933年1月，据悉博蒙特与一名声誉可疑的人士“吉米”·利亚多（"Jimmy" Llado）相识。1933年1月31日，法国警察在霞飞路（Avenue Foch）805号的一家赌馆内发现了博蒙特，但未对其提起诉讼。

在1933年9月21日的《观察家报》上，一篇署名为A.W.博蒙特、题为《揭露上海白人奴隶贸易》的文章引起了人们对该期刊的极大关注。这篇报道将上海描绘成一个公开纵容罪恶的城市，在那里白人妇女被毫无阻碍地买卖，冷酷无情的白人妇女通过无情剥削其不幸的姐妹们来致富。宽容

pages.en:
- 3 -
-confidential

and liberalism were ideals on which any great metropolis
should be conducted, the article averred, but it was
evident that the under-lying purport of the story was to
embarrass the local authorities.

In 1934 Beaumont made a trip to Hangchow where
he was married to a Russian Jewess, his friend and
advisor Me. d'Auxion de Ruffe officiating.

On March 1, 1933 Beaumont removed from the I.S.S.
Apartments, Avenue Joffre to 310 Majestic Apartments,
Bubbling Well Road, where he remained until April 20, 1934,
when he was ejected by his landlords, the Asia Realty
Company, for non-payment of rent. He then stayed at the
Embassy Hotel, Bubbling Well Road, until May 8, 1934.

On April 30, 1934 Beaumont made arrangements
with Messrs. Brandt & Rodgers, No. 391 Kiangse Road, for
the leasing of Apartment "J", The Jafa Court, No. 255
RueMgr. Mareca, premises into which he moved on May 10,
1934.

Beaumont's publication the "Shanghai Spectator"
is now located on the 2nd floor, No. 80 Nanking Road, to
which it removed in 1934.

Beaumont is now residing in the Embassy Hotel.
pages.zh:
- 3 -
-机密

和自由主义是任何大都市都应遵循的理想，文章声称，但显然该故事的潜在意图是让地方当局难堪。

1934年，博蒙特前往杭州旅行，并在那里与一名俄罗斯犹太女子结婚，他的朋友兼顾问德奥克西翁·德吕夫先生（Me. d'Auxion de Ruffe）主持了婚礼。

1933年3月1日，博蒙特从霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）的国际储蓄社公寓（I.S.S. Apartments）搬至静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）310号美琪公寓（Majestic Apartments），他一直居住到1934年4月20日，当时因拖欠租金被房东亚细亚地产公司（Asia Realty Company）驱逐。随后他入住静安寺路的 Embassy Hotel（译名待定，通常指华懋饭店或类似名称，此处保留原文或译为使馆饭店，根据上下文及当时习惯，Embassy Hotel常指位于静安寺路的某旅馆，暂译为使馆饭店），直至1934年5月8日。

1934年4月30日，博蒙特与江西路391号的布兰特和罗杰斯律师事务所（Messrs. Brandt & Rodgers）达成协议，租赁马雷卡主教路（Rue Mgr. Mareca）255号贾法公寓（The Jafa Court）的“J”室，他于1934年5月10日搬入该处。

博蒙特出版的《上海观察家报》目前位于南京路80号二楼，该报于1934年迁至此处。

博蒙特现居住在使馆饭店（Embassy Hotel）。

pages.en:
Adolphe Elie Beaumont whose real name is
Adolphe Israelowicz, was born at Antwerp, Belgium of
Polish parents on March 4, 1897. His father, now
deceased, was Maurice Israelowicz and his mother,
whose maiden name was Tauber, is still residing in
Belgium.

At various times during his sojourn in
Shanghai, Beaumont has claimed to be a naturalised
American, but in refutation of this assertion, the
local United States Consul-General has stated that
he is not recognised as such. He has, however,
been registered at the local Belgian Consulate-
General under the name of Israelowicz since February
20, 1930 and moreover is the possessor of a Belgian
passport which bear the inscription "Israelowicz
dit Beaumont." (Israelowicz alias Beaumont).

Beaumont first came to the notice of the
Shanghai Municipal Police following his arrival in
Shanghai on June 14, 1929 by the S.S. "Empress of
Russia," after having been deported from the United
States of America. It appears that in June 1928
Beaumont arrived in Victoria, B.C. and shortly after-
wards crossed the Canadian border into the United
States, where a few weeks later he was detected,
apprehended, and deported on the ground of illegal
entry. In this connection it is of interest to
note that the American Warrant of Deportation No.
56839-677 issued against Beaumont bears the following
particulars:
pages.zh:
阿道夫·埃利·博蒙特（Adolphe Elie Beaumont），真名为阿道夫·伊斯雷洛维奇（Adolphe Israelowicz），1897年3月4日出生于比利时安特卫普，父母均为波兰人。其父莫里斯·伊斯雷洛维奇（Maurice Israelowicz）已故，其母婚前姓陶伯（Tauber），仍居住在比利时。

在上海逗留期间，博蒙特曾多次声称自己是归化美国公民，但为反驳这一说法，当地美国总领事馆声明并不承认其拥有此身份。然而，自1930年2月20日以来，他已在当地比利时总领事馆以伊斯雷洛维奇（Israelowicz）之名登记，并且持有一本比利时护照，上面印有“Israelowicz dit Beaumont”（即伊斯雷洛维奇，又称博蒙特）的字样。

博蒙特首次引起上海公共租界工部局警务处的注意，是在他于1929年6月14日乘坐“俄罗斯皇后号”（S.S. "Empress of Russia"）抵达上海之后，此前他刚从美利坚合众国被驱逐出境。看来，博蒙特于1928年6月抵达不列颠哥伦比亚省的维多利亚市，不久后越过加拿大边境进入美国，几周后他因非法入境被发现、逮捕并被驱逐。在这方面，值得注意的是，针对博蒙特签发的美国驱逐令第56839-677号载有以下详细信息：

pages.en:
- 2 -

"Born April 22, 1901 at Bucharest, Romania.
"Last arrival in U.S.A. at Blaine, Washington.
"Departure - April 30, 1929 from Victoria, B.C."

It is presumed that the above details relating to Beaumont's place and date of birth were copied by the American authorities at the time of his apprehension prior to his deportation, from documents then in his possession. These particulars, it will be noticed, are totally different from those known to the Belgian Consulate-General in Shanghai, so there is a possibility of Beaumont having had, or still being in possession of, papers of two different nationalities.

In July 1929; Beaumont announced to the Shanghai public through the local press that he intended opening a new golf club at Ying Kiang Long. Allied with him in this venture was an American lawyer named H.J. Rodger. The Riverview Golf Club came into existence shortly after Beaumont's announcement, but proved a financial failure. Beaumont next interested himself in the promotion of a motor-cycle race track. This new sport was introduced to the Shanghai public at the "Speedway" in the grounds of the now defunct Greyhound Racecourse, off Kiaochow Road. Like his previous venture, this concern was soon in financial difficulties and at the beginning of 1930 was compelled to close down. Whilst the "Speedway" was still in operation Beaumont became managing-director of an American registered corporation known as Velodrome Inc. After many delays this concern opened a cycle racing and amusement resort on Avenue Haig in April 1930, but by October of the same year he was sued in the Amer-
pages.zh:
- 2 -

“1901年4月22日出生于罗马尼亚布加勒斯特。
“最后一次抵达美国地点：华盛顿州布莱恩（Blaine）。
“离境日期——1929年4月30日，从不列颠哥伦比亚省维多利亚市出发。”

据推测，上述关于博蒙特出生地点和日期的细节，是美国当局在他被逮捕并驱逐前，从他当时持有的文件中抄录的。值得注意的是，这些细节与上海比利时总领事馆所掌握的情况完全不同，因此博蒙特可能曾经持有，或者仍然持有两种不同国籍的文件。

1929年7月，博蒙特通过当地媒体向上海公众宣布，他打算在引翔港（Ying Kiang Long）开设一家新的高尔夫俱乐部。与他合作进行这项 venture 的是一位名叫H.J.罗杰（H.J. Rodger）的美国律师。在博蒙特宣布后不久，里弗维尤高尔夫俱乐部（Riverview Golf Club）成立，但证明在财务上是失败的。接着，博蒙特又致力于推广摩托车赛道。这项新运动在上海胶州路（Kiaochow Road）旁已废弃的赛狗场场地内的“ Speedway ”（高速赛道）向上海公众推出。像他之前的 venture 一样，这家企业很快陷入财务困境，并于1930年初被迫关闭。当“ Speedway ”仍在运营时，博蒙特成为一家名为 Velodrome Inc. 的美国注册公司的董事总经理。经过多次延误，该企业于1930年4月在爱文义路（Avenue Haig）开设了一家自行车赛车及娱乐度假村，但同年10月，他被美-

pages.en:
- 3 -
from court by the International Advertising Agency
for $500.00 when judgment was rendered against him.
Shortly after, the Velodrome ceased to exist as an
amusement resort and it is known that a great number
of accounts were still unsettled when the corporation
terminated its activities.
Bennett next appeared in the role of editor
of the "Shanghai Spectator," a semi-sporting and soc-
ial paper of distinct scurrilous tendencies, which
made its initial appearance during 1931. He has
always given out that he, alone, is the owner of this
publication, but according to our information the
real owner of this periodical is Mr. d'Amico de
Ruffo, a well-known attorney and barrister-at-law,
who practices locally. Some twenty years ago this
gentleman was expelled from a magistracy which he then
held in Indo-China on account of a breach of profes-
sional etiquette, and as recently as January, February
and April, 1933 articles written by him under the nom-
de-plume of Ajax viciously attacking the administrat-
ions of the Shanghai Municipal Council and the local
Chinese Government, appeared in the "Spectator."
Bennett's efforts in the local world of journalism are
regarded in certain circles here with scorn as it is
known that in compiling certain pages for the "Spectator"
he employs tactics which smack of blackmail. On
February 27, 1932 - during the local Sino-Japanese
hostilities - he launched a cheap midday publication
termed the "Daily Express" from his office at No. 3
Museum Road. This venture, however, flourished for
only a few days until the Sino-Japanese truce came
to a halt. Bennett is also believed to have been
pages.zh:

国国际广告公司起诉索赔500.00美元，法院判决对他不利。此后不久，Velodrome 作为娱乐度假村不复存在，众所周知，当该公司终止活动时，仍有大量账目未结清。
接下来，贝内特（Bennett，注：此处原文人名突然变为Bennett，疑为档案笔误，实际指代同一人Beaumont，按原文译出）以《上海观察家报》编辑的身份出现，这是一份具有明显诽谤倾向的半体育、半社交类报纸，于1931年首次发行。他总是宣称自己是该出版物的唯一所有者，但根据我方情报，该期刊的真正所有者是达米科·德鲁福（d'Amico de Ruffo）先生，这是一位在当地执业的知名律师和大律师。约二十年前，这位绅士因违反职业礼仪被逐出其在印度支那担任的法官职位。就在1933年1月、2月和4月，他以笔名“阿贾克斯”（Ajax）撰写的猛烈攻击上海工部局和当地中国政府行政当局的文章出现在《观察家报》上。贝内特在当地新闻界的努力受到某些圈子的蔑视，因为众所周知，他在为《观察家报》编纂某些版面时，采用了带有敲诈勒索意味的手段。1932年2月27日——正值当地中日冲突期间——他在博物馆路3号的办公室推出了一份名为《每日快报》的廉价午间出版物。然而，这项 venture 仅维持了几天，直到中日停战协定中止。据信，贝内特还曾

pages.en:

several times during the same month Beaumont was
seen to visit the now defunct Pacific Club, No.
56A Hart Road, which was established for purposes
of gambling. On January 1, 1933 the local
French police raided No. 803 Avenue Foch having
received information to the effect that gambling
was being conducted there. Among the persons
apprehended was Beaumont, who was alleged to be
one of the principals of the place, but through
lack of evidence he was eventually released and
was not charged.

In June 1933, a former Russian employee
of the Asia Realty Company, No. 50 Nanking Road,
visited the Belgian Consulate-General and declar-
ed that he had revealed to Beaumont certain facts
about the company's accounts, and that he feared
that Beaumont was going to use them in an article
in the "Spectator." When summoned to the con-
sulate for purpose of interrogation regarding
this report, Beaumont admitted having prepared
such an article, but stated that before publishing
it he would obtain the approval of Dr. Sellett,
United States District Attorney, as he did not de-
sire to offend American susceptibilities. The
statements he had made about the Asia Realty Coy.
were true, he declared, and after Dr. Sellett had
seen the article, he (Dr. Sellett) saw no object-
ion to its being published.

The article in question which appeared
in the "Spectator" of June 28, 1933 was calculated
to cause the Asia Realty Company embarrassment; a
similar article regarding the company's activities
pages.zh:
- 5 -

同月数次，有人看到博蒙特访问现已不复存在的哈特路（Hart Road）56A号的太平洋俱乐部（Pacific Club），该俱乐部是为赌博目的而设立的。1933年1月1日，当地法国警察接到情报称霞飞路（Avenue Foch）803号正在进行赌博活动，遂对该处进行突击搜查。在被捕人员中包括博蒙特，他被指控为该场所的主要负责人之一，但因证据不足，他最终被释放且未被起诉。

1933年6月，亚细亚地产公司（位于南京路50号）的一名前俄罗斯雇员访问了比利时总领事馆，并声明他曾向博蒙特透露了有关该公司账目的某些事实，他担心博蒙特会在《观察家报》的一篇文章中使用这些信息。当博蒙特被传唤至领事馆就此事接受讯问时，他承认准备了这样一篇文章，但表示在发表之前，他会获得美国地区检察官塞莱特博士（Dr. Sellett）的批准，因为他不想冒犯美国人的情感。他宣称，他对亚细亚地产公司所做的陈述是真实的，并且在塞莱特博士看过这篇文章后，他（塞莱特博士）对发表该文没有异议。

这篇引起争议的文章发表于1933年6月28日的《观察家报》，旨在使亚细亚地产公司难堪；另一篇关于该公司活动的类似文章

pages.en:
- 6 -

was published in the "Spectator" dated June 29, 1933.

In the "Spectator" of September 21, 1933
an article over the name of . . Beaumont entitled
"Shanghai White Slave Traffic Exposed" was given
great publicity. This story depicted Shanghai as
a city where vice was indulged in openly, where
white women were bought and sold without hindrance
and where ruthless white women enriched themselves
through the pitiless exploitation of their less
fortunate sisters. Tolerance and liberalism were
ideals on which any great metropolis should be con-
ducted, the article averred, but it was evident
that the underlying purport of the story was to em-
barrass the local authorities.

Prior to the article being published, it
is known that Beaumont approached Miss Edge Kennedy,
the keeper of a brothel at No. 473 Kiangsu Road,
and stated that for certain financial considerations,
he would refrain from publishing the story in ques-
tion. Miss Kennedy, however, refused to part with
any money with the result that the article was pub-
lished.

Many articles couched in a similar obnox-
ious nature appeared in the "Spectator" from time to
time between June 1932 and March 1934, the majority
of which were directed against the Shanghai Municipal
Council's administrative policy with the ulterior
motive of championing his own cause and later his own
election campaign as a member of the Municipal Coun-
cil.

In November 1933 a "Pro-Shanghai Group,"
sponsored by Beaumont was inaugurated with the object
of interesting foreigners, especially Russians, in a
so called "Civic Reform Movement." An article
pages.zh:
- 6 -

发表于1933年6月29日的《观察家报》。

在1933年9月21日的《观察家报》上，一篇署名为 . . 博蒙特、题为《揭露上海白人奴隶贸易》的文章得到了大肆宣传。这篇报道将上海描绘成一个公开纵容罪恶的城市，在那里白人妇女被毫无阻碍地买卖，冷酷无情的白人妇女通过无情剥削其不幸的姐妹们来致富。文章声称，宽容和自由主义是任何大都市都应遵循的理想，但显然该故事的潜在意图是让地方当局难堪。

在该文章发表之前，据悉博蒙特接触了江苏路473号一家妓院的经营者肯尼迪小姐（Miss Edge Kennedy），并表示出于一定的金钱考虑，他将 refrain from 发表该故事。然而，肯尼迪小姐拒绝支付任何款项，结果导致该文章得以发表。

在1932年6月至1934年3月期间，《观察家报》不时刊登许多性质同样令人反感的文章，其中大多数是针对上海工部局的行政政策，其 ulterior motive 是为了宣扬他自己的主张，以及后来为他竞选工部局议员铺路。

1933年11月，由博蒙特发起的“亲上海团体”（Pro-Shanghai Group）正式成立，旨在吸引外国人，特别是俄罗斯人，参与所谓的“市政改革运动”。一篇文章

pages.en:
- 7 -

...titled "Municipal," which appeared in a November
issue of the "Spectator," and apart from criticizing
the system of municipal administration in the Inter-
national Settlement, contained an appeal to local
"White" Russian ratepayers to overcome the inferior-
ity complex from which they were suffering, to unite
and organize themselves prior to the 1934 election
in order to secure on the Municipal Council a seat
for their representative who would assist them in
acquiring civic rights in the Settlement equal to
those enjoyed by other foreigners.

The appearance on January 14, 1934 of a
Russian language edition of the "Spectator" was another
phase of the campaign launched by Bernant, and
the main underlying points of the articles appear-
ing in this issue were carefully planned steps to
obtain support, morally and financially, for his
"Pro-Shanghai Group." Viewing this campaign in
retrospect and bearing in mind Bernant's previous
ventures into the world of finance, there appears to
be little doubt that his carefully thought out
schemes were in the nature of a business proposition
in which he was to be the sole beneficiary.

The "Shanghai Zaria," a local Russian daily
favourably commented on Bernant's schemes and agreed
with the basic statements of the "Group," namely,
that the time had arrived and was opportune for Rus-
sian ratepayers to participate in the administration
of local municipal affairs.

On the other hand, "Slovo," another local
Russian daily, regarded with an undisguised suspicion
the strange and mysterious efforts on the part of an
almost unknown foreigner to save Russian emigrants at
pages.zh:
- 7 -

……题为“市政”的文章，刊登在十一月出版的《旁观者》（Spectator）杂志上，除了批评国际租界的市政管理体系外，还呼吁当地俄国“白俄”纳税人克服他们正遭受的自卑情结，在1934年选举前团结并组织起来，以便在工部局董事会中为其代表争取一个席位，该代表将协助他们在租界内获得与其他外国人同等的公民权利。

1934年1月14日，《旁观者》俄文版的出现是伯南特（Bernant）发起的运动的一个新阶段，该期刊登文章的主要潜在要点是经过精心策划的步骤，旨在为他的“亲上海团体”（Pro-Shanghai Group）获取道义上和财政上的支持。回顾这场运动，并考虑到伯南特此前在金融界的冒险经历，几乎可以肯定，他深思熟虑的计划本质上是一项商业提议，而他是唯一的受益人。

当地一家俄文日报《上海扎里亚报》（Shanghai Zaria）对伯南特的计划给予了有利的评价，并同意该“团体”的基本主张，即俄国纳税人参与地方市政事务管理的时机已经成熟且正当。

另一方面，另一家当地俄文日报《斯洛沃报》（Slovo）则毫不掩饰地怀疑一个几乎不为人知的外国人试图拯救俄国移民的奇怪而神秘的举动，当时这些移民在面对远东政治事件时，毫无抵抗地表现出强烈的统一倾向，而这些事件对俄国移民的重要性远超过任何地方事务。

time when the latter, without resistance, showed
a strong tendency towards unification in the face
of political events in the Far East, the importance
of which for Russian migrants was greater by far
than any local affairs.

As a result of this article no support for
Beaumont's campaign was forthcoming from responsible
Russian circles, by whom he was regarded as a person
of doubtful reputation, while his unwarranted inter-
vention on behalf of the Russian community was
much resented by them.

Continuing his activities on behalf of the
'Pro-Shanghai Group,' Beaumont was nominated for the
post of a 1934-5 Shanghai Municipal councillor by Mr.
Arthur de Carvalho and seconded by Mr. J. Heinsdin-
er on March 15, 1934. In an effort to secure el-
ection Beaumont and his few adherents carried out
an extensive propaganda campaign and offered the
public a platform the contents of which were well-
nigh impossible of consummation. At the polls on
March 26 and 27, 1934, however, Beaumont was miser-
ably defeated.

Prior to the election Beaumont's activit-
ies and aspirations were bitterly attacked and more
than strongly condemned by the "Kopeika," another
local Russian daily, the editor of which is one V.A.
Chilikin. The bona fides of Beaumont's antecedents
were strongly questioned in a series of articles
penned by Chilikin and there was no doubt that these
exposés were meant to prejudice Beaumont's chances
in the election in the eyes of Russian voters.

Chilikin's efforts to belittle Beaumont
were apparently so successful that on February 24,
pages.zh:
- C -

由于这篇文章，博蒙特（Beaumont）的运动并未从负责任的俄国圈子中获得任何支持，这些人认为他是一个声誉可疑的人，而他未经请求代表俄国社区进行的干预引起了他们的极大不满。

博蒙特继续代表“亲上海团体”开展活动，于1934年3月15日由阿瑟·德·卡瓦略先生（Mr. Arthur de Carvalho）提名，并由J. 海因斯迪纳先生（Mr. J. Heinsdiner）附议，竞选1934-1935年度上海工部局董事。为了确保当选，博蒙特及其少数追随者进行了广泛的宣传运动，并向公众提供了一个其内容几乎不可能实现的纲领。然而，在1934年3月26日和27日的投票中，博蒙特惨败。

在选举之前，博蒙特的活动和野心遭到了另一家当地俄文日报《戈比卡报》（Kopeika）的猛烈攻击和强烈谴责，该报编辑为V.A. 奇利金（V.A. Chilikin）。奇利金撰写的一系列文章强烈质疑博蒙特背景的诚信，毫无疑问，这些揭露意在损害博蒙特在俄国选民眼中的形象，从而影响其当选机会。

奇利金贬低博蒙特的努力显然非常成功，以至于在1934年2月24日，

pages.en:
- 9 -

1934 Beaumont filed a private criminal prosecution
against Bilikin in the Montreal Recorder's Court on
the ground that malicious libel had
been committed and that the statements contained in
various issues of the "Montreal Star" were falsely
manufactured to the detriment of his character and
thus had seriously affected his chances of being
successful in his election quest. After several
hearings, the case was remanded sine die on March
29, 1934.

After his defeat at the Municipal elections,
Beaumont issued a manifesto stating that he, on be-
half of the 'Pro-Shanghai Group,' intended calling a
special ratepayers' meeting to be held immediately
after the regular meeting at the Ritz Theatre on
April 18, 1934 for the purpose of carrying certain
resolutions aiming at reforms within the council. At
the last moment, however, owing to lack of support
and funds, the 'Pro-Shanghai Group' abandoned its
scheme and to all intents and purposes its activit-
ies have terminated.

On April 18, 1934 several sub-contractors
employed by Etoile d'Art Inc., 50, Rue Dubbling Rail-
road, proceeded to that company's premises and re-
quested payment for work performed by them at the
Grand Theatre, Auditorium and several other amuse-
ment resorts in the Settlement and French Concession.
Beaumont, who had been connected with Etoile d'Art, Inc.
since 1931, asserted that these sub-contractors had
not completed their assignments, but it was signifi-
cant that inspite of this statement, the sub-contract-
ors were given post-dated cheques on the Chase Bank,
pages.zh:
- 9 -

博蒙特在蒙特利尔记录法院（Montreal Recorder's Court）对比利金（Bilikin）（注：原文此处拼写为Bilikin，前文为Chilikin，依原文译出）提起私人刑事诉讼，理由是对方犯有恶意诽谤罪，且《蒙特利尔星报》（Montreal Star）各期所载陈述系捏造，损害了他的名誉，从而严重影响了他在选举追求中的成功机会。经过几次听证后，该案于1934年3月29日被无限期延期审理。

在工部局选举失败后，博蒙特发表了一份宣言，称他代表“亲上海团体”，打算在1934年4月18日丽兹剧院（Ritz Theatre）例行会议结束后立即召开一次特别的纳税人会议，目的是通过某些旨在改革董事会的决议。然而，在最后时刻，由于缺乏支持和资金，“亲上海团体”放弃了该计划，其活动实际上已终止。

1934年4月18日，受雇于艺术之星公司（Etoile d'Art Inc.，地址：Rue Dubbling Railroad 50号）的几名分包商前往该公司办公地点，要求支付他们在公共租界和法租界的大戏院（Grand Theatre）、礼堂及其他几处娱乐场所完成的工作款项。自1931年以来一直与艺术之星公司有关联的博蒙特声称，这些分包商尚未完成他们的任务，但值得注意的是，尽管有此说法，分包商还是收到了大通银行（Chase Bank）的远期支票，

At the time of sealing it was ascertained

On the same day it was made known that the Kung Ling
Electro-plating Works had obtained judgment against

45. C' i blaug cord, n yllr on ov 71. 1934. t is（原文不清/乱码）
然而，值得注意的是，当于1933年11月10日向银行查询时，艺术工作室公司（Studio d'Art Inc.）的总信用额度仅为1.57。上述面值为17.20的一张支票于1934年5月31日提示付款，但因资金不足被退回给开票人。该支票由开票人重新提示付款于…… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… …… ……

同样值得注意的是，在1934年4月和5月期间，以艺术工作室公司（Studio d'Art Inc.）在上海联合信托有限公司（Union Trust Co., Ltd.）账户开出的五十多张支票，总金额达3713.00，因资金不足无法兑付，被退还给收款人，并注明“请与开票人联系”（refer to drawer）。

1934年4月20日，应该公司一名债权人的请求，上海第一特区地方法院发布命令，查封了艺术工作室公司的办公室和仓库。人们普遍认为该公司在美国总领事馆注册，但经调查证实并非如此；此举纯粹是由孔令律师事务所（Messrs. Kung Ling & Co.）作为诉讼代理人，在当地地方法院针对该公司采取的行动。

查封时查明，艺术工作室公司的几名债权人此前一直未对公司提起诉讼，因为他们相信这是一家在美国注册的公司。同日获悉，孔令电镀厂已于1933年12月9日获得对该公司的判决，金额约为2,800.00美元。判决后未进行任何支付，法院于1934年初批准了查封场所的命令，但直到1934年4月20日才执行。

This furniture and decorating business was
first commenced by two Frenchmen in 1924 or 1925 on
Avenue Joffre and was conducted on a small scale.
Two years later, Mr. Tseong Yih ( 鍾 垚 ), a
Chinese returned art and interior decorating student
from France, bought it over and named it Studio d'
Art and gradually commenced extending the business.
In 1931 Mr. Tseong agreed to have Beaumont organise
the firm for him on a sounder basis in order to be
able to expand, and on November 18, 1931 the concern
was incorporated under the laws of the State of Delaware, U.S.A.

In the latter part of the summer of 1933,
Mr. Tseong left for France on vacation with his
French wife and left Beaumont in charge of Studio d'
Art Inc., and allowed him 25% of the net profits of
the company as his commission, as he had been assured

1934年5月4日，比利时领事法院领事法官A. 胡耶（A. Houyet）开庭审理了一起民事诉讼案。该案由公司前业主钟先生（Mr. Tsoong）起诉A.W. 博蒙特先生，要求收回艺术工作室公司名义价值为每股100.00的800股优先股。

钟先生由保罗·弗朗内律师（Me. Paul Franet）代理，要求博蒙特以80,000.00的名义价值归还这些股份，理由是这些股份交给后者是为了让他代钟先生出售。如果股份未被处置，钟先生要求归还。博蒙特通过其代理人德·奥克西翁·德·拉夫律师（Me. d'Auxion de Raffe）辩称，他对这些股份不承担任何责任，并提交了一份由原告签署并由他（博蒙特）见证的文件，文件中钟先生以“一美元现付”的价格将股份转让给艺术工作室公司总经理杰罗姆·皮尔斯先生（Mr. Jerome Pierce）。

"Born April 22, 1901 at Bucharest, Rumania.
"Last arrival in U.S.A. at Blaine, Washington.
"Departure - April 30, 1929 from Victoria, B.C."

It is presumed that the above details relating to Beaumont's place and date of birth were copied by the American authorities at the time of his apprehension prior to his deportation, from documents then in his possession. These particulars, it will be noticed, are totally different from those known to the Belgian Consulate-General in Shanghai, so there is a possibility of Beaumont having had, or still being in possession of, papers of two different nationalities.

In July 1929, Beaumont announced to the Shanghai public through the local press that he intended opening a new golf club at Ying Hsiang Long. Allied with him in this venture was an American lawyer named H.J. Rodger. The Riverview Golf Club came into existence shortly after Beaumont's announcement, but proved a financial failure. Beaumont next interested himself in the promotion of a motorcycle race track. This new sport was introduced to the Shanghai public at the "Speedway" in the grounds of the now defunct Grayhound Racecourse, off Kiaochow Road. Like his previous venture, this concern was soon in financial difficulties and at the beginning of 1930 was compelled to close down. Whilst the "Speedway" was still in operation Beaumont became managing-director of an American registered corporation known as Velodrome Inc. After many delays this concern opened a cycle racing and amusement resort on Avenue Haig in April 1930, but by October of the same year he was sued in the Amer-
pages.zh:

“1901 年 4 月 22 日出生于罗马尼亚布加勒斯特。
“最后一次抵达美国地点为华盛顿州布莱恩。
“离境 – 1929 年 4 月 30 日从不列颠哥伦比亚省维多利亚出发。”

据推测，上述关于 Beaumont 出生地和日期的细节是美国当局在他被逮捕并驱逐出境前，从他当时持有的文件中抄录的。值得注意的是，这些信息与上海比利时总领事馆所掌握的情况完全不同，因此 Beaumont 可能拥有或仍然持有两种不同国籍的文件。

1929 年 7 月，Beaumont 通过当地媒体向上海公众宣布，他打算在引翔港（Ying Hsiang Long）开设一家新的高尔夫俱乐部。与他合作这项 venture 的是一位名叫 H.J. Rodger 的美国律师。在 Beaumont 宣布后不久，Riverview Golf Club（江景高尔夫俱乐部）成立，但证明在财务上是失败的。接着，Beaumont 又致力于推广摩托车赛道。这项新运动在上海胶州路旁已废弃的格雷hound赛马场（Grayhound Racecourse，原文如此，应为 Greyhound）内的“Speedway”（高速赛车场）向上海公众推出。像他之前的 venture 一样，这项业务很快陷入财务困境，并于 1930 年初被迫关闭。当“Speedway”仍在运营时，Beaumont 成为了一家在美国注册的名为 Velodrome Inc. 的公司的董事总经理。经过多次延误，该公司于 1930 年 4 月在海格路（Avenue Haig）开设了一个自行车赛和娱乐度假村，但同年 10 月，他在美国

ican court by the International advertising agency
for $500.00 when judgment was rendered against him.
Shortly after, the Valodoro ceased to exist as an
amusement resort and it is known that a great number
of accounts were still unsettled when the corporation
terminated its activities.
Beaumont next appeared in the role of editor
of the "Shanghai Spectator," a semi-sporting and soc-
ial paper of distinct scurrilous tendencies, which
made its initial appearance during 1931. He has
always given out that he, alone, is the owner of this
publication, but according to our information the
real owner of this periodical is Mr. d'Auxion de
Ruffe, a well-known attorney and barrister-at-law,
who practices locally. Some twenty years ago this
gentleman was expelled from a magistracy which he then
held in Indo-China on account of a breach of profes-
sional etiquette, and as recently as January, February
and April, 1933 articles written by him under the pseu-
do-name of Ajax violently attacking the administrat-
ions of the Shanghai Municipal Council and the Local
Chinese Government, appeared in the "Spectator."
Beaumont's efforts in the local world of journalism are
regarded in certain circles here with scorn as it is
known that in compiling certain pages for the "Spectator"
he employs tactics which smack of blackmail. On
February 27, 1932 - during the local Sino-Japanese
hostilities - he launched a cheap midday publication
termed the "Daily Express" from his office at No. 3
Amoy Road. This venture, however, flourished for
only a few days until the Sino-Japanese truce came
to a halt. Beaumont is also believed to have been

法院被 International Advertising Agency（国际广告代理公司）起诉索赔 500.00 美元，判决对他不利。不久之后，Valodoro（原文如此，前文为 Velodrome）作为娱乐场所停止存在，众所周知，当该公司终止活动时，仍有大量账目未结清。
Beaumont 接下来以《上海观察家》（Shanghai Spectator）编辑的身份出现，这是一份带有明显诽谤倾向的半体育半社交报纸，于 1931 年首次发行。他一直声称自己是该出版物的唯一所有者，但根据我们的信息，该期刊的真正所有者是 d'Auxion de Ruffe 先生，一位在当地执业的知名律师和大律师。约二十年前，这位绅士因违反职业礼仪被逐出其在印度支那担任的 magistracy（司法官职）。就在 1933 年 1 月、2 月和 4 月，他以 Ajax 为笔名撰写的猛烈攻击上海工部局和中国地方政府当局的文章出现在《观察家》上。Beaumont 在当地新闻界的努力受到这里某些圈子的蔑视，因为众所周知，他在编纂《观察家》的某些版面时，采用了带有勒索意味的手段。1932 年 2 月 27 日——在当地中日冲突期间——他从厦门路 3 号的办公室推出了一份廉价的午间出版物，名为《每日快报》（Daily Express）。然而，这项 venture 仅繁荣了几天，直到中日停战协定破裂。Beaumont 也被认为曾

responsible for the publication of a periodical of
the magazine type entitled "Sporting Life."

Whilst in Paris during 1928, Beaumont under
the name of Jaremowicz, was the instigator of a
ca. $5,000,000.00 fraud jewels, precious stones, etc.,
upon Messrs. Blumenthal Freres. Upon the swindle
being disclosed, Beaumont hurriedly left France in
order to escape arrest, but was convicted by default
and sentenced to five (5) years' imprisonment and a
fine of ca. $5,000.00. No attempts have been made
by the French authorities to have him extradited, it
being considered that such steps would be entirely
unprofitable.

In October or November of 1932 Beaumont was
convicted at the local Belgian Court in an action for
defamation of character brought by a Russian money-
lender named J.J. Surovich, No. 457 Klongan Road, and
was sentenced to ten (10) days' imprisonment, a
penalty which was later commuted to a fine, which was
paid.

It is known that he owes considerable sums
of money to various business establishments in Shang-
hai and information gathered from various reliable
sources indicates that several complaints have been
made against this individual regarding non-payment
of debts. In this connection the Belgian author-
ities summoned Beaumont to the Consulate during the
summer of 1932 for the purpose of questioning him,
as a result of which Beaumont promised to pay off
his creditors at the rate of $40.00 per month.

In January 1933 it became known that Beau-
mont was an acquaintance of "Jimmy" Liede, a notor-
ious gambler and conductor of several secret gambling
dens throughout the Settlement and French Concession.

1928年在巴黎期间，博蒙特（Beaumont）使用雅雷莫维奇（Jaremowicz）之名，策划了一起针对布卢门塔尔兄弟公司（Messrs. Blumenthal Freres）的诈骗案，涉案珠宝、宝石等价值约5,000,000.00美元。骗局败露后，博蒙特为逃避逮捕匆忙离开法国，但被缺席定罪，判处五（5）年监禁并罚款约5,000.00美元。法国当局未尝试将其引渡，认为此类行动完全无益。

1932年10月或11月，博蒙特在比利时当地法院因一名名为J.J.苏罗维奇（J.J. Surovich，地址：康加南路457号）的俄罗斯放贷人提起的名誉诽谤诉讼中被定罪，被判十（10）天监禁，该刑罚后减为罚款，并已缴纳。

据悉，他欠上海多家商号巨额款项，从各种可靠来源收集的信息表明，已有多起针对此人的投诉，指控其拖欠债务。为此，比利时当局于1932年夏季传唤博蒙特至领事馆进行问讯，结果博蒙特承诺以每月40.00美元的速度偿还债权人。

1933年1月，获悉博蒙特与“吉米”利德（"Jimmy" Liede）相识，后者是一名臭名昭著的赌徒，在公共租界和法租界经营多家秘密赌场。

was published in the "Spectator" dated June 3, 1933.
In the "Spectator" of September 1, 1933
an article over the name of . . . Beaumont entitled
"Shanghai white slave traffic exposed" was given
great publicity. This story depicted Shanghai as
a city where vice was indulged in openly, where
white women were bought and sold without hindrance
and where ruthless white women enriched themselves
through the pitiless exploitation of their less
fortunate sisters. Tolerance and liberalism were
ideals on which any great metropolis should be con-
ducted, the article averred, but it was evident
that the underlying purport of the story was to em-
barrass the local authorities.

Prior to the article being published, it
is known that Beaumont approached Miss Agnes Kennedy,
the keeper of a brothel at No. 473 Ningpo Road,
and stated that for certain financial considerations,
he would refrain from publishing the story in ques-
tion. Miss Kennedy, however, refused to part with
any money with the result that the article was pub-
lished.

Many articles couched in a similar obnox-
ious nature appeared in the "Spectator" from time to
time between June 1932 and March 1934, the majority
of which were directed against the Shanghai Municipal
Council's administrative policy with the ulterior
motive of championing his own cause and later his own
election campaign as a member of the Municipal Coun-
cil.

In November 1933 a "Pro-Shanghai Group,"
sponsored by Beaumont was inaugurated with the object
of interesting foreigners, especially Russians, in a
so called "Civic Reform Movement." An article

刊登于1933年6月3日的《观察家报》（Spectator）。
在1933年9月1日的《观察家报》上，一篇署名为……博蒙特的题为《揭露上海白奴贸易》的文章得到了大量宣传。该故事将上海描绘成一个公然纵容罪恶的城市，白人妇女可以毫无阻碍地被买卖，无情的白人妇女通过无情地剥削她们不幸的姐妹来致富。文章声称，宽容和自由主义是任何大都市都应遵循的理想，但显然，该故事的潜在意图是让地方当局难堪。

在该文章发表之前，据悉博蒙特曾接触宁波路473号一家妓院的经营者阿格尼丝·肯尼迪（Agnes Kennedy）小姐，并表示出于某些财务考虑，他将不发表该有争议的故事。然而，肯尼迪小姐拒绝支付任何金钱，结果该文章得以发表。

1932年6月至1934年3月间，《观察家报》不时刊登许多性质同样令人反感的文章，其中大多数针对上海工部局的行政政策，其潜在动机是为他自己的事业辩护，并为其后来竞选工部局董事铺路。

1933年11月，由博蒙特发起的“亲上海团体”（Pro-Shanghai Group）成立，旨在吸引外国人，特别是俄罗斯人，参与所谓的“市政改革运动”。一篇文章

The experience at January 14, 1927 of a
special general meeting of the "press corps" was another
instance of L. S. Skvertzoff's persistent, as
the main underlying purpose of the articles appearing
in this issue was carefully planned steps to
attain support, morally and financially, for his
proposed project. Viewing this occasion in
retrospect and bearing in mind Skvertzoff's previous
ventures into the world of finance, there appears to
be little doubt that his carefully thought out
scheme was in reality but of a business proposition
in which he was to be the sole beneficiary.

The "Shanghai Daily," a local Russian daily
journalistically commented on Skvertzoff's schemes and agreed
with the basic statements of the "Crisis," namely,
that the time had arrived and was opportune for Rus-
sian ratepayers to participate in the administration
of local municipal affairs.

On the other hand, "Slovo," another local
Russian daily, responded with un disguised suspicion
the strange and mysterious efforts on the part of an
almost unknown foreigner to save Russian emigrants at

政治局势，出现在多期《公报》（Gazette）上，除了概述各租界类似的行政体系外，还呼吁各地的白俄克服他们正在遭受的自卑情结，团结起来并在他们自己的领导下，为了恢复或在市议会中获得席位——他声称他将协助他们获得这一席位。这使得他们在租界享有与其他外国人同等的权利。

1927年1月14日，“记者团”特别大会的经历是L.S.斯克维尔佐夫（L. S. Skvertzoff） persistent（原文如此，意为坚持/持续）的另一个例子，因为本期出现的文章的主要潜在目的是精心策划的步骤，以为他的提议项目争取道德和财政支持。回顾这一场合，并考虑到斯克维尔佐夫此前在金融界的冒险经历，毫无疑问，他深思熟虑的计划实际上只是一个商业提案，而他将是唯一的受益者。

上海当地的一家俄文日报《上海日报》（Shanghai Daily）对斯克维尔佐夫的计划进行了新闻评论，并同意《危机》（Crisis）的基本观点，即俄罗斯纳税人参与地方市政事务管理的时机已经成熟且正当。

另一方面，另一家当地俄文日报《言论报》（Slovo）则以毫不掩饰的怀疑态度回应了一名几乎不为人知的外国人试图拯救俄罗斯移民的奇怪而神秘的努力，在

As a result of this attitude no support for
Beaumont's campaign was forthcoming from responsible
Russian circles, by whom he was regarded as a person

Notwithstanding his activities on behalf of the

Arthur de Carvalho and seconded by Dr. J. Lalandin -
on March 15, 1934. In an effort to secure el-

an extensive propaganda campaign and offered the
public a platform the contents of which were well-
nigh impossible of comprehension. At the polls on
March 26 and 27, 1934, however, Beaumont was miser-
ably defeated.

Prior to the election Beaumont's activit-
ies and aspirations were bitterly attacked and more
than strongly condemned by the "Rossiia," another
local Russian daily, the editor of which is one V.A.
Chilikin. The bona fides of Beaumont's antecedents
were strongly questioned in a series of articles
penned by Chilikin and there was no doubt that these
exposures were meant to prejudice Beaumont's chances
in the election in the eyes of Russian voters.

Chilikin's efforts to belittle Beaumont
were apparently so successful that on February 24,

由于这种态度，博蒙特的竞选活动未能获得负责任的俄罗斯圈子的支持，这些人认为他是一个声誉可疑的人，而他代表俄罗斯社区进行的无理干涉引起了他们的极大反感。

尽管博蒙特为“上海团体”开展了活动，但他仍由阿瑟·德·卡瓦略（Arthur de Carvalho）先生提名，并由J.拉兰丁（J. Lalandin）博士附议，竞选1934-1935年度上海工部局董事，提名日期为1934年3月15日。为了确保当选，博蒙特及其少数追随者开展了广泛的宣传运动，并向公众提供了一个内容几乎无法理解的平台。然而，在1934年3月26日和27日的投票中，博蒙特惨败。

在选举之前，博蒙特的活动和野心遭到了另一家当地俄文日报《俄罗斯报》（Rossiia）的猛烈攻击和强烈谴责，该报编辑为V.A.奇利金（V.A. Chilikin）。奇利金撰写的一系列文章强烈质疑博蒙特背景的真实性，毫无疑问，这些曝光意在影响俄罗斯选民眼中博蒙特的当选机会。

奇利金贬低博蒙特的努力显然非常成功，以至于在2月24日，

1934 Vermaat filed a private criminal prosecution
against Millikin in the British Supreme Court at
Shanghai on the ground that malicious libel had
been committed and that the statements contained in
certain issues of the "North China Daily News" were
manufactured to the detriment of his character and
that he had seriously affected his chances of being
successful in his election quest. After several
hearings, the case was dismissed by the court on
March 20, 1934.

After his defeat in the Municipal elections,
Vermaat issued a manifesto stating that he, on be-
half of the "Pro-Shanghai Group," intended calling a
special ratepayers' meeting to be held immediately
after the regular meeting at the Altona Theatre on
April 18, 1934 for the purpose of carrying certain
resolutions aiming at reforms within the council. At
the last moment, however, owing to lack of support
and funds, the "Pro-Shanghai Group" abandoned its
scheme and to all intents and purposes its activit-
ies have terminated.

On April 18, 1934 several sub-contractors
employed by Studio d'Art Inc., No. 156 Bubbling Well
Road, proceeded to that company's premises and re-
quested payment for work performed by them at the
Grand Theatre, Auditorium and several other amuse-
ment resorts in the Settlement and French Concession.
Vermaat, who had been connected with Studio d'Art, Inc.
since 1931, asserted that these sub-contractors had
not completed their assignments, but it was signifi-
cant that inspite of this statement, the sub-contract-
ors were given post-dated cheques on the Chase Bank,

1934年，韦尔马特（Vermaat）在上海英国最高法院对米利金（Millikin）提起私人刑事诉讼，理由是犯有恶意诽谤罪，且《字林西报》（North China Daily News）某些期刊中包含的陈述系捏造，损害了他的名誉，并严重影响了他在竞选中的成功机会。经过几次听证，法院于1934年3月20日驳回了此案。

在工部局选举失败后，韦尔马特发表了一份宣言，称他代表“亲上海团体”，打算在1934年4月18日于阿尔托纳剧院（Altona Theatre）举行的常规会议之后立即召开一次特别的纳税人会议，目的是通过某些旨在改革工部局的决议。然而，在最后时刻，由于缺乏支持和资金，“亲上海团体”放弃了该计划，其活动在各方面实际上已经终止。

1934年4月18日，受雇于静安寺路156号艺术工作室股份有限公司（Studio d'Art Inc.）的几名分包商前往该公司办公地点，要求支付他们在公共租界和法租界的大戏院（Grand Theatre）、礼堂及其他几处娱乐场所完成的工作款项。自1931年以来一直与艺术工作室股份有限公司有关联的韦尔马特声称，这些分包商尚未完成他们的任务，但值得注意的是，尽管有此说法，分包商还是收到了大通银行（Chase Bank）的远期支票，

bore the signatures of J. Beaumont and Jos J. Rice.

It is also noteworthy that during April and
May, 1934 more than fifty cheques issued by account
to various persons on the Union Mobiliere, 'ue Pont-
neuf, for amounts totalling $915.00 were returned
to the people to whom they were made payable with
the annotation "refer to drawer," there being no
funds to meet them.

On April 20, 1934 the offices and stores
of Radio d'Art Inc. were sealed by an order issued
by the Shanghai First Special District Court, at
the instance of one of the creditors of the company.
It was generally believed that the concern was reg-
istered at the American Consulate-General, but upon
investigation it was revealed that such was not the
case and action was accordingly taken against the
company in the local district court by Messrs. Kung
Shing Electro-Plating Works.

At the time of sealing it was ascertained
that several creditors of Radio d'Art Inc. had, up
till then, failed to file suits against the company,
believing it to be an American registered concern.
On the same day it was made known that the Kung Shing
Electro-Plating Works had obtained judgment against

1934年4月20日，应该公司一名债权人的请求，上海第一特区地方法院发布命令，查封了Radio d'Art Inc.（原文如此，前文为Studio d'Art Inc.）的办公室和仓库。人们普遍认为该公司在美国总领事馆注册，但经调查证实并非如此，因此孔兴电镀厂（Kung Shing Electro-Plating Works）在当地地方法院对该公司采取了行动。

查封时查明，Radio d'Art Inc.的几名债权人此前一直未对公司提起诉讼，因为他们相信这是一家在美国注册的公司。同日获悉，孔兴电镀厂已获得针对

On April 21, 1934 the seals were removed
on Beaumont's instructions, which resulted in another
visit to the premises by the District Court officials who again sealed the doors. Beaumont later
denied that the debt in question was applicable to
the firm, but was incurred by a former Chinese employee. A few days later the seals were finally
removed when it became known that the concern enjoyed American protection, and therefore was not
amenable to the jurisdiction of the Shanghai First
Special District Court.

This furniture and decorating business was
first commenced by two Frenchmen in 1924 or 1925 on
Avenue Joffre and was conducted on a small scale.
Two years later, Mr. Tseng Yih ( 程 垚 ), a
Chinese returned art and interior decorating student
from France, bought it over and named it Studio d'
Art and gradually commenced extending the business.
In 1931 Mr. Tseng agreed to have Beaumont organize
the firm for him on a sounder basis in order to be
able to expand, and on November 18, 1931 the concern
was incorporated under the laws of the State of Delaware, U.S.A.

In the latter part of the summer of 1933,
Mr. Tseng left for France on vacation with his
French wife and left Beaumont in charge of Studio d'
Art Inc., and allowed him 25% of the net profits of
the company as his commission, as he had been assured

该商号于1923年12月9日涉及约2,800.00美元的债务。针对该判决未进行任何支付，法院于1934年初下达了查封场所的命令，但直到1934年4月20日才执行。

1934年4月21日，封条根据博蒙特（Beaumont）的指示被移除，这导致地方法院官员再次前往该场所并重新查封了大门。博蒙特后来否认上述债务适用于该商行，称该债务是由一名前中国雇员产生的。几天后，当得知该商号享有美国保护，因此不受上海第一特区地方法院管辖时，封条最终被移除。

这家家具和装饰业务最初由两名法国人于1924或1925年在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）创办，规模较小。两年后，程垚（Tseng Yih）先生，一位从法国归来的艺术与室内装饰专业留学生，买下了该业务，并将其命名为“艺术工作室”（Studio d'Art），随后逐渐开始扩展业务。1931年，程先生同意让博蒙特以更稳固的基础为他组建公司，以便能够扩张，于是该商号于1931年11月18日根据美国特拉华州法律注册成立。

1933年夏末，程先生与其法国妻子前往法国度假，留下博蒙特负责管理“艺术工作室股份有限公司”（Studio d'Art Inc.），并允许他获得公司净利润的25%作为佣金，因为他曾向程先生保证

1934年5月4日，该公司前业主程先生（Mr. Tseong）针对A. W. 博蒙特先生提起的一项民事诉讼开庭，要求收回“艺术工作室股份有限公司”名义价值各为100.00的800股提及股份，该案在比利时领事法庭由领事法官A. Houyet主持审理。

程先生由保罗·雷莫（Paul Remot）律师代理，声称这些股份是以80,000.00的名义价值交给博蒙特的，目的是让他代为出售。如果股份未被处置，程先生要求归还。博蒙特通过其律师d'Auxion de Ruffe先生辩称，他对这些股份不承担任何责任，并提交了一份由原告签署并由他（博蒙特）见证的文件，其中程先生以“一美元现付”的价格将股份转让给“艺术工作室股份有限公司”的总经理杰罗姆·海斯先生。

出示该文件后，Tsaoong先生承认那是他的签名，但坚称当时并不知道自己在签什么。Tsaoong先生和Paul Janset律师均向法庭指出，如果股份是前者于1933年9月11日转让的，为何博蒙特于1933年12月17日向他身在法国的收件人发电报，出价50,000.00美元？Tsaoong先生进一步指出，博蒙特曾向他提供公司净利润的30%。所有这些指控均被博蒙特否认，他声称1933年12月发给Tsaoong先生的电报是关于后者与公司签订的一份合同。

听证会于1934年5月11日恢复，博蒙特及其律师Me. d'Uslon de Raffe均未出庭。诉讼开始时宣读了一封来自律师的信。该信函声称，此案不属于比利时领事法庭的管辖范围，同时对案件的审理方式提出异议，指出这是一起民事而非刑事诉讼。律师进一步表示，将向布鲁塞尔最高法院提出上诉和异议。

此后，法庭询问了Tsaoong先生

affairs of Studio d'Art, prior to and after incorp-
oration were related by Mr. Tsoong. It was also

produced showing that Beaumont had cabled Mr. Tsoong

Criminal charges were later laid by Ms.
Paul Prout against Beaumont in connection with the

was held in abeyance pending the investigation of

Several witnesses were examined in camera
at the Belgian Consulate-General on May 24, 1934 in
regard to the criminal case and as soon as the "juge
d'instruction" has reached a decision as to whether
a criminal case can be brought here against Beaumont,
the matter will be made public.

Further proof of Beaumont's financial in-

博蒙特缺乏资金的进一步证据最近在1934年5月27日得到证实，当时他的雪铁龙轿车（牌照号5138）因未分期付款而被霞飞路424-426号法国大车库（Grand Garage Francais）的代表扣押。博蒙特于1933年10月7日获得该车，签署了价值33,120.00法郎的合同，并支付了7,000.00法郎作为首期付款。他定期支付从100.00墨西哥元到279.00墨西哥元不等的款项，直到1934年3月，他开始拖欠付款，最终导致了上述事件。

在1934年上海公共租界工部局选举前不久，以及前往杭州的一次旅行中，他按照中式风格与一位俄罗斯男爵夫人结婚，他的朋友兼顾问d'Aunian de Ruffo先生（音译）主持了婚礼。

Lagosee，即今蒲西路附近，原文拼写可能有误）265号嘉福公寓（The Jafa Court）的“J”室，他于1934年5月10日搬入。1934年5月18日，博蒙特向其新公寓的房东Brandt & Rodgers先生寄送了一张310.00美元的支票，用于支付第一个月的租金，该支票由蒙塔班街（Rue Montauban）的Union Mobiliere（投资银行家）开出。这张日期为1934年4月30日、收款人为Brandt & Rodgers先生的支票被银行退回，并注明“咨询出票人”（refer to drawer），因为账户内无资金支付。该支票最初由A.W.博蒙特签署。

With reference to the various paragraphs
of this memorandum which indicate Belgium's me-
chanism for issuing cheques without provision for
meeting them, the following is a translation from
Article 538 bis of the Belgian Penal Code ( Law
of March 25, 1938, Article 1):-

"Penalty of one month to two years'
"imprisonment and a fine of from Frs.26
to Frs.3000 shall be imposed on:
1) any person who knowingly issues
without sufficient provision (funds)
available in advance, a cheque or any
other document as payment in cash and
at sight on available funds.
2) any person who parts with one of
these documents knowing that the
funds are insufficient and are not
available.
3) The drawer who knowingly withdraws
the whole or part of the funds of one
of these documents, within three months
of its issue.
4) The drawer who, with fraudulent intent
or with the purpose of producing, renders
unavailable, all or a part of the funds
of one of these documents."

关于本备忘录中提及比利时签发无资金保证支票之机制的各段落，以下是1938年3月25日法律第一条所修订的《比利时刑法典》第538条之二（Article 538 bis）的译文：-

“应判处一个月至两年监禁，并处26法郎至3000法郎罚款的对象包括：
1) 任何在明知预先没有足够准备金（资金）的情况下，签发以可用资金即时支付现金的支票或任何其他单据的人。
2) 任何在明知资金不足且不可用的情况下，交付上述任何一种单据的人。
3) 出票人在签发上述任何一种单据后的三个月内，明知故犯地提取该单据全部或部分资金者。
4) 出票人出于欺诈意图或为了制造假象，致使上述任何一种单据的全部或部分资金无法动用者。”

Studio Art
Is Attached

U.S. Court Order Gives
Landlord Opportunity
To Recoup Back Rent

A crisis point in the history of
Studio Art, Inc., furnishing and
decorating company, at 136 East 57th
Street was reached yesterday
when some of the furniture in the
show rooms was removed to the
bonded godown of the Commercial
Express and Storage Company under
the order of the United States
Court for China.

The attachment was made by
Messrs. Calatrava, Hsieh and Co.,
the landlords of the premises, who
claim back rent since the beginning
of the year amounting to about
$6,000. The real estate firm obtained
the attachment for landlord's
lien from the United States Court
for China through their attorney,
Mr. J. C. Watson, of the law firm
of Watson and Harrington.

Studio Art has been in the
limelight during the last few weeks.
On April 24 the premises were
placed under order of the First Spe-
cial Branch Court upon the request
of Mr. Tsoong Shih-Chang,
former owner, who had filed a
petition against the present man-
agement. In December last the
stock accounts were taken over by
April 24 at the request of the
American authorities, who informed
the district court that Studio Art
was not an American concern
but was registered in Shanghai,
China as well as all other
concerns.

Studio Art
已被查封

美国法院命令给予房东
追回欠租的机会

位于东57街136号的家具与装饰公司 Studio Art, Inc. 的历史于昨日达到危机时刻，当时根据在华美国法院的命令，其陈列室中的一些家具被移至商业快递仓储公司（Commercial Express and Storage Company）的保税仓库。

此次查封由该处所的房东 Calatrava, Hsieh and Co. 事务所执行，他们声称自年初以来拖欠租金约6,000美元。这家房地产公司通过其律师、Watson and Harrington 律师事务所的 J. C. Watson 先生，从在华美国法院获得了针对房东留置权的查封令。

Studio Art 在过去几周一直备受瞩目。4月24日，应前业主 Tsoong Shih-Chang（音译）先生的请求，第一特别分院法庭下令接管该处所，他曾对现任管理层提起诉讼。去年12月，库存账目已于4月24日应美国当局的请求被接管，美国当局通知地区法院，Studio Art 并非美国企业，而是像所有其他企业一样在中国上海注册。

China Press, May 12, 1934.

Shanghai
Final Hearing
Of Beaumont
Suit Is Held

Studio d'Art Case To Be
Settled By Belgian
Court Next Monday

Defendant Fails To
Appear In Tribunal

Notwithstanding the non-appearance before the Belgian Consular Court yesterday afternoon of A. W. Beaumont (Karatovitch) and his attorney, Mr. Taurion de Bieffe, the hearing of the civil action for the recovery of 100,000 dollars for the recovery of 100 shares alleged to be at the nominal value of Tls. 50 each in the Studio D'Art, Inc., was held, and a decision reserved.

Beaumont was summoned to appear but failed to do so. The company was represented by its president, Mr. Tchang, and its attorney, Mr. C. A. Hodge. Judgment will be handed down on Monday afternoon.

The hearing of the civil suit in which Mr. Beaumont, represented by Monsieur Paul Prevost, claims the return of 100 shares, the nominal value of which is Tls. 50 each, in the Studio D'Art, Inc., took place yesterday afternoon at the Belgian Consular Court. Mr. Beaumont, president of the company, and his attorney, Mr. Taurion de Bieffe, failed to appear.

The full text of the judgment will be published later. It is understood that the court found that the shares were sold by Mr. Beaumont to Mr. Tchang for "one dollar in hand paid."

The various affairs of the Studio D'Art prior and after incorporation were related by Mr. Tchang. It was also alleged by him and by Dr. Sun that Beaumont had obtained the share certificates, which were in custody of Dr. Sun, under false pretenses. Testimony was adduced showing that Mr. Beaumont had called Mr. Tchang in Paris in connection with offering him 100,000 for the shares. Mr. Tchang stated that he did not accept the offer. He said that the shares belonged to the company and that he had no right to sell them.

It was further alleged that when he handed over the shares to Mr. Beaumont, the latter promised to give them back to Mr. Tchang in a few days, but never did so. After a short time, Mr. Tchang discovered that the shares had been transferred to a third party.

《字林西报》，1934年5月12日。

上海
Beaumont
诉讼案
举行最终听证会

Studio d'Art 案将于
下周一由比利时
法院裁决

被告未出庭

尽管 A. W. Beaumont (Karatovitch) 及其律师 Taurion de Bieffe 先生昨日下午未出现在比利时领事法庭，但关于追讨 Studio D'Art, Inc. 公司 alleged（声称）面值为每股票银50两的100股股份、索赔10万美元的民事诉讼听证会仍照常举行，判决保留待宣。

Beaumont 曾被传唤出庭但未履行。该公司由其总裁 Tchang 先生及其律师 C. A. Hodge 先生代表。判决书将于周一下午宣读。

昨日下午，比利时领事法庭审理了这起民事诉讼案，Beaumont 先生由 Paul Prevost 先生代理，要求归还 Studio D'Art, Inc. 公司面值为每股票银50两的100股股份。Beaumont 先生，该公司总裁，及其律师 Taurion de Bieffe 先生均未出庭。

判决书全文将稍后公布。据悉，法院认定这些股份是 Beaumont 先生以“一美元现付”的价格卖给 Tchang 先生的。

Tchang 先生陈述了 Studio D'Art 在注册成立之前及之后的各项事务。他和 Sun 博士还指控 Beaumont 通过虚假借口获取了由 Sun 博士保管的股票证书。有证词显示，Beaumont 先生曾在巴黎就出价10万购买股份一事致电 Tchang 先生。Tchang 先生表示他未接受该报价。他说这些股份属于公司，他无权出售。

此外还指控称，当他将股份交给 Beaumont 先生时，后者承诺几天后归还给 Tchang 先生，但从未兑现。不久后，Tchang 先生发现股份已被转让给第三方。

立即付款。昨日的意外行动以 Paul Prevost 先生的发言告终。法官和陪审员休庭片刻，随后决定退庭，并将于周一宣判。

(批注：附卷 & Beaumont 档案。J.V. Price 5月13日)

May 9, 1934. Afternoon Translation.

Iron News (鐵報), a mosquito paper, dated May 8:-

BEAMOUNT CHARGED WITH FRAUD.

At the recent election of new Councillors of the
S.I.C., Beamount, a Belgian, who was desirous of obtaining
a seat on the Council, advertised on a large scale and
issued statements. His efforts were unsuccessful and
he was keenly disappointed.
Beamount is now being prosecuted at the Belgian
Consulate. The case opened a few days ago and from a
statement made by the Belgian Consul it is obvious that
Beamount is a member of the loafer class.
Beamount's original name was Israelovitch. He
has previous convictions. According to the Belgian Consul,
Israelovitch was sentenced to eight days' imprisonment in
1930 in connection with a criminal case. Israelovitch
was involved in the following cases which have not yet been
concluded:-
1) Criminal case brought against him by Dallas regarding
the Velodrome. Date: October 22, 1930.
2) Case brought against him by Noans (?) (拿奧司) in
November 1930.
3) Illegally receiving and spending tailors fees on
July 10, 1930. Tailors concerned did not receive
the money and filed a petition against him.
4) Obtaining by fraud several thousand dollars from a
Spaniard in March 1932 for the purpose of organizing
a newspaper agency.
The present case against Beamount was filed by
a Chinese named Tsoong Yih (鐘煌) on a charge of fraud
and having illegally occupied the premises of the Studio
d' Art. Beamount told many lies during the hearing, but
became silent when the Belgian Consul refuted his statements.
The case is remanded until Friday.

（批：Tico）

5月8日出版的蚊报《铁报》：-

BEAMOUNT 被控欺诈。

在近期工部局新董事选举中，渴望获得董事会席位的比利时人 Beamount 进行了大规模广告宣传并发布声明。他的努力未能成功，令他深感失望。
Beamount 目前正在比利时领事馆受审。该案于数日前开庭，从比利时领事的声明中可以明显看出，Beamount 属于游手好闲之流。
Beamount 的原名是 Israelovitch。他有前科。据比利时领事称，Israelovitch 在1930年因一起刑事案件被判处八天监禁。Israelovitch 还卷入以下尚未结案的案件：-
1) Dallas 就跑马厅（Velodrome）一事对他提起的刑事诉讼。日期：1930年10月22日。
2) Noans (?)（拿奧司）于1930年11月对他提起的案件。
3) 1930年7月10日非法收取并花费裁缝费用。相关裁缝未收到款项，并对他提起诉讼。
4) 1932年3月，以组织新闻社为目的，从一名西班牙人处诈骗数千美元。
目前针对 Beamount 的案件是由一名名为 Tsoong Yih（鐘煌）的中国人提起的，指控其欺诈及非法占用 Studio d'Art 的处所。Beamount 在听证期间说了许多谎话，但当比利时领事驳斥其陈述时，他便沉默不语。
案件延期至周五审理。

（批注：Tico）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. R. G. L. Y.
No. D 3307
Date 1 / 5 / 34

THE CHINA PRESS · SATURDAY, MAY 5, 1934

A. W. Beaumont
Sues Suit For
Share Recovery

Ex-Proprietor Of Studio
D'Art Brings Action;
Hearing Is Adjourned

The hearing of a civil action for the recovery of 600 preferred shares of the nominal value of Tls. 100 each of the Studio D'Art, Inc., furnishing and decorating company, brought by Mr. Sun Tehong, former proprietor of the company, against Mr. A. W. Beaumont (American) was opened in the Belgian Consular Court before Judge A. Borrel yesterday afternoon.

Mr. Tehong, represented by Mr. Paul Fremet, claims the return of these shares at a nominal value of Tls. 60,000 from Mr. Beaumont, president of the furniture firm which is registered in the State of Delaware, on the ground that the shares were handed over to him in order that he should sell them for Mr. Tehong.

In the event the shares have not been sold Mr. Tehong asks for their return. Mr. Beaumont, through his attorney Mr. d'Auxion de Ruffe, contends that he is in no way responsible for the shares and produced a document signed by Mr. Tehong and witnessed by him in which Mr. Tehong transfers the shares to Mr. Jerome Marks, an American citizen and the present managing director of the Studio D'Art, for "one dollar in hand paid." After a lengthy session the hearing was adjourned until next Friday.

Word Of Transfer

The case of transfer, which is dated September 11, 1933, reads as follows: "In consideration of one dollar (one American dollar) in hand paid and other valuable considerations, I hereby sell, assign, transfer and set over unto Jerome Marks, 600 shares of the preferred stock of the Studio D'Art, Inc., a corporation organized and existing under the laws of the State of Delaware, standing in my name on the books of said corporation, with full power of substitution in the premises, hereby authorizing and directing the said corporation to transfer the said shares on its books. In witness whereof I have hereunto set my hand and seal this 11th day of September, 1933. (Signed) Sun Tehong."

Mr. Fremet stated that Mr. Tehong had signed all the share certificates in blank and gave them to Dr. Sun, a friend of his, for safe keeping. In December, while in Europe, he received an offer by cable from Mr. Beaumont to sell the shares and cabled his consent. It was alleged by Mr. Fremet that Mr. Beaumont then went to Dr. Sun with the cable and asked him to hand over the shares, which Dr. Sun did, thinking that everything was in order.

This allegation was denied by Mr. d'Auxion de Ruffe, who stated that if there was any claim it should be made against Mr. Marks, who was not subject to the jurisdiction of the Belgian Court. Mr. Fremet requested the permission of the court to call Dr. Sun as a witness, which was granted.

The shares over which the action was brought were produced in court by Mr. D'Auxion de Ruffe and examined. Mr. Tehong repeated that they were his property and that they were the property of Mr. Marks, who is an American citizen, and was allowed to examine them.

（批：8427）
（批：Jwd）
（批：Jul 22）

《字林西报》 · 1934年5月5日，星期六

A. W. Beaumont
被诉要求
归还股份

Studio D'Art 前业主
提起诉讼；
听证会延期

昨日下午，Studio D'Art, Inc. 家具与装饰公司前业主 Sun Tehong 先生对美国籍人士 A. W. Beaumont 先生提起的、要求归还该公司面值为每股票银100两的600股优先股的民事诉讼听证会，在比利时领事法庭由 A. Borrel 法官主持开庭。

Tehong 先生由 Paul Fremet 先生代理，要求 Beaumont 先生归还这些名义价值为票银60,000两的股份，理由是这些股份交给他只是为了让他代 Tehong 先生出售。Beaumont 先生是这家在特拉华州注册的家具公司的总裁。

如果股份未被出售，Tehong 先生要求归还。Beaumont 先生通过其律师 d'Auxion de Ruffe 先生辩称，他对这些股份不承担任何责任，并提交了一份由 Tehong 先生签署、由他见证的文件，其中 Tehong 先生将股份转让给美国公民、Studio D'Art 现任总经理 Jerome Marks 先生，价格为“一美元现付”。经过长时间的庭审，听证会延期至下周五。

转让事宜

这份日期为1933年9月11日的转让文件内容如下：“鉴于已现付一美元（一美国元）及其他有价值的对价，我在此出售、分配、转让并过户给 Jerome Marks 600股 Studio D'Art, Inc. 的优先股，该公司系根据特拉华州法律组建并存续，上述股份登记在我名下，拥有完全的替代权，在此授权并指示该公司在其账簿上转让上述股份。特此为证，我于1933年9月11日在此签字盖章。（签名）Sun Tehong。”

Fremet 先生陈述说，Tehong 先生已在所有股票证书上空白签名，并将其交给他的朋友 Sun 博士保管。12月，他在欧洲期间收到 Beaumont 先生发来的关于出售股份的电报报价，并回电同意。Fremet 先生指控称，Beaumont 先生随后持该电报去找 Sun 博士，要求他交出股份，Sun 博士以为一切妥当便照办了。

d'Auxion de Ruffe 先生否认了这一指控，他表示，如果有任何索赔，应向 Marks 先生提出，而 Marks 先生不受比利时法院管辖。Fremet 先生请求法庭允许传唤 Sun 博士作为证人，获准。

诉讼涉及的股票由 D'Auxion de Ruffe 先生在法庭上出示并接受查验。Tehong 先生重申这些是他的财产，而 Marks 先生是美国公民，也被允许查验这些股票。

THE CHINA PRESS, SATURDAY, MAY 5, 1934

A.W. Beaumont
Faces Suit For
Share Recovery

Ex-Proprietor Of Studio
D'Art Brings Action;
Hearing Is Adjourned

The hearing of a civil action for the recovery of 800 preferred shares at the nominal value of Tls. 100 each, of the Studio D'Art, Inc., furnishing and decorating company, brought by Mr. Pan Tchong, former proprietor of the company, against Mr. A. W. Beaumont (Israelovitch) was opened in the Belgian Consular Court before Consular Judge A. Houyet yesterday afternoon.

Mr. Tchong, represented by Mr. Paul Premet, claims the return of these shares at a nominal value of Tls. 80,000 from Mr. Beaumont, president of the furniture firm which is registered in the State of Delaware, on the ground that the shares were handed over to him in order that he should sell them for Mr. Tchong.

In the event the shares have not been sold Mr. Tchong asks for their return. Mr. Beaumont, through his attorney Mr. d'Auxion de Ruffe, contends that he is in no way responsible for the shares and produced a document signed by Mr. Tchong and witnessed by him in which Mr. Tchong transfers the shares to Mr. Jerome Marcs, an American citizen and the present managing director of the Studio D'Art, for "one dollar in hand paid." After a lengthy session the hearing was adjourned until next Friday.

Text Of Transfer

The note of transfer, which is dated September 11, 1933, reads as follows: "In consideration for $1 (one mexican dollar) in hand paid and other valuable consideration, I hereby sell, transfer and assign 800 (eight hundred) shares of preferred stock of Studio D'Art, Inc., to Jerome Marcs." Signed "P. Tchong." Witnessed "A. W. Beaumont."

Shown the document, Mr. Tchong admitted that it was his signature, but said that he did not know what he was signing at the time. Mr. Tchong and Paul Premet both pointed out to the court that if the shares were transferred by Mr. Tchong on September 11, 1933 why did Mr. Beaumont cable him in Paris on December 17, 1933 asking him to sell the shares?

Mr. Premet stated that this was the only proof that Mr. Tchong had with the company.

Received Offer

It was pointed out by Mr. Premet that when Mr. Tchong left for France he signed all the share certificates in blank and gave them to Dr. Sun, a friend of his, for safe keeping. In December, while in Paris, he received an offer by cable from Mr. Beaumont to sell the shares and cabled his consent. It was alleged by Mr. Premet that Mr. Beaumont then went to Dr. Sun with the cable and asked him to hand over the shares, which Dr. Sun did, thinking that everything was in order.

This allegation was denied by Mr. d'Auxion de Ruffe, who stated that if there was any claim it should be made against Mr. Marcs, who was not subject to the jurisdiction of the Belgian Court. Mr. Premet requested the permission of the court to call Dr. Sun as a witness, which was granted.

The shares over which the action was brought were produced in court by Mr. D'Auxion de Ruffe and examined. Mr. Tchong requested that they should be deposited with the court, but Mr. d'Auxion de Ruffe pointed out that they were the property of Mr. Marcs, who is an American citizen, and was allowed to retain them.

《字林西报》，1934年5月5日，星期六

A.W. 博蒙特
面临股份追回诉讼

艺术工作室（Studio D'Art）前业主提起诉讼；听证会延期

昨日下午，在比利时领事法庭，由领事法官 A. Houyet 主持，开庭审理了一起民事诉讼案。该案由艺术工作室股份有限公司（Studio D'Art, Inc.，一家家具与装饰公司）的前业主潘忠（Pan Tchong）先生提起，被告为 A. W. 博蒙特（Israelovitch）先生，诉求为追回面值为每份100两白银的800股优先股。

潘忠先生由保罗·普雷梅特（Paul Premet）律师代理，声称博蒙特先生作为这家在特拉华州注册的家具公司的总裁，应以80,000两白银的面值归还这些股票，理由是这些股票是交给他代为出售给潘忠先生的。

如果股票尚未售出，潘忠先生要求予以归还。博蒙特先生通过其律师 d'Auxion de Ruffe 先生辩称，他对这些股票不承担任何责任，并出示了一份由潘忠先生签署、经他见证的文件，文件中潘忠先生以“一美元现付”为对价，将股票转让给美国公民、现任艺术工作室总经理的杰罗姆·马克斯（Jerome Marcs）。经过长时间的庭审，听证会延期至下周五继续。

转让文书文本

该转让便条日期为1933年9月11日，内容如下：“鉴于已收到1美元（壹墨西哥元）现付及其他有价值之对价，本人特此出售、转让并分配艺术工作室股份有限公司（Studio D'Art, Inc.）的800（捌佰）股优先股给杰罗姆·马克斯。”签署人：“P. Tchong”。见证人：“A. W. Beaumont”。

出示该文件后，潘忠先生承认那是他的签名，但称当时并不知道自己在签什么。潘忠先生和保罗·普雷梅特均向法庭指出，如果潘忠先生已于1933年9月11日转让了股票，为何博蒙特先生还要在1933年12月17日从巴黎发电报给他，要求他出售股票？

普雷梅特先生表示，这是潘忠先生拥有的关于该公司的唯一证据。

收到要约

普雷梅特先生指出，潘忠先生前往法国时，在所有股票证书上空白签名，并将其交给他的朋友孙博士（Dr. Sun）保管。12月，他在巴黎收到博蒙特先生发来的出售股票的电报要约，并回电同意。普雷梅特先生指控称，博蒙特先生随后持该电报去找孙博士，要求交出股票，孙博士以为一切手续完备，便照办了。

d'Auxion de Ruffe 先生否认了这一指控，并表示如果有任何索赔，应向马克斯先生提出，而马克斯先生不受比利时法庭的管辖。普雷梅特先生请求法庭允许传唤孙博士作为证人，获准。

涉案股票由 d'Auxion de Ruffe 先生在法庭上出示并接受查验。潘忠先生要求将股票存放于法庭，但 d'Auxion de Ruffe 先生指出，这些股票是美国公民马克斯先生的财产，因此获准由其保留。

China Press, April 26, 1934.

Studio D'Art
Opens Again
After Closure

Harassed Furniture
Firm Gets Bars Taken
Down By District Court

With the question of jurisdiction
over Studio D'art Inc., furnishers
and decorators, 128 Bubbling Well
Road, cleared up as result of the
American consular authorities hav-
ing sent a letter to the president
of the First Special District Court
informing him that the company
was incorporated in Delaware and
registered at the American Consul-
ate, the seals placed upon the two
show rooms of the furniture firm
last Friday were taken off by the
District Court officials yesterday
morning.

The two show rooms of Studio
D'Art were sealed upon the order of
the Chinese court after a judgment
had been obtained against the fur-
niture firm by the Kong Shing
Electro-Plating Works for $2,800 on
December 9. The judgment was
obtained by default and was in no
way contested as regards the claim
or jurisdiction by officials of the
Studio D'Art.

Last Friday the electro-plating
firm obtained an order from the
court to execute its judgment and,
not receiving payment of the sum
due, an order to seal the premises
was issued. The question of juris-
diction then came up. The Ameri-
can Consulate did not offer the firm
proper protection as they had failed
to register at the consulate although
incorporated in Delaware.

However, due to their failure to
register at the proper time, they
were closed for business from last
Friday until yesterday morning. It
is understood that with the question
of jurisdiction settled, Kong Shing
will bring action against the Studio
D'Art as soon as the United States
Court for China begins to function.

Mr. J. Mires, managing director
of Studio D'Art, however, stated
that the debt to the Chinese firm
had been satisfied by a check sent
from New York.

《字林西报》，1934年4月26日。

艺术工作室
关闭后
重新开业

受困扰的家具公司
地方法院移除封条

随着对美国领事当局致函第一特区地方法院院长一事的结果澄清了关于艺术工作室股份有限公司（Studio D'art Inc.，家具商与装饰商，南京路128号）的管辖权问题——信中告知该院该公司在特拉华州注册并在美国领事馆登记——上周五贴在该家具公司两个展厅上的封条，于昨天上午由地方法院官员移除。

艺术工作室的两个展厅是在中国法院于12月9日就孔兴电镀厂（Kong Shing Electro-Plating Works）对该家具公司作出的2,800美元判决后，根据中国法院的命令被封存的。该判决为缺席判决，艺术工作室的官员并未就索赔或管辖权问题提出任何异议。

上周五，电镀厂从法院获得执行判决的命令，因未收到应付款项，法院发布了查封场所的命令。此时管辖权问题浮现。美国领事馆未能给予该公司适当保护，因为尽管其在特拉华州注册，却未在领事馆登记。

然而，由于未能及时登记，该公司从上周五至昨天上午一直停业。据悉，随着管辖权问题的解决，一旦美国在华法院开始运作，孔兴厂将对艺术工作室提起诉讼。

不过，艺术工作室总经理 J. Mires 先生表示，欠中国公司的债务已通过从纽约寄出的支票清偿。

（批注：博蒙特

China Press, April 22, 1934.

Studio D'Art
Doors Resealed
By New Order

American Jurisdiction
Over Corporation
Proved In Formalities

Beaumont Says Company
Will Reopen Tomorrow

Upon being informed that seals placed on the two showrooms of Studio D'Art (Inc.) 126 Bubbling Well Road, on Friday upon the request of one of the creditors of the company had been removed, officials of the First Special District Court together with runners of the Sinza Station were sent down yesterday morning to execute a court order and re-seal the doors.

A letter was drafted by the American Consulate-General to the First Special District Court yesterday morning informing the latter that Studio D'Art is an American company and therefore not subject to the jurisdiction of the Chinese Court and at the same time asking that the seals placed upon the premises of the company be removed. The letter will probably be forwarded tomorrow morning.

Delay Caused Trouble

Mr. A. W. Beaumont, editor of the Shanghai Spectator, who signs as "Publicity Representative of Studio D'Art, Inc." in an interview yesterday denied having at any time been manager of the firm. He pointed out that the neglect to register the company at the American Consulate until the actual day of the sealing, had caused all the trouble.

Mr. Beaumont admitted during the interview that the irregularity was probably due to officials of Studio D'Art overlooking having received a District court notification that judgment had been given against them by default for about $2,800 in favor of Messrs. Kong Shing Electric Wiring Works. The judgment was given on December 6, 1933.

The statement issued by the company, however, reads: "Studio D'Art strenuously denies this claim, according to Mr. J. Marc..."

（批：Attach to Beaumont file 23/4 ong）

《字林西报》，1934年4月22日。

艺术工作室
大门依新令
再次被封

公司在形式上证明
受美国管辖

博蒙特称公司将于明日重开

获悉周五应公司一位债权人的请求贴在南京路126号艺术工作室（股份有限公司）两个展厅上的封条被移除后，第一特区地方法院的官员会同新闸捕房的巡捕于昨天上午前往执行法院命令，重新封门。

美国总领事馆于昨天上午起草了一封致第一特区地方法院的信函，告知后者艺术工作室是一家美国公司，因此不受中国法院管辖，同时要求移除贴在公司场所上的封条。该信函可能于明天上午发出。

延误引发麻烦

《上海观察家报》编辑、在采访中以“艺术工作室股份有限公司宣传代表”署名的 A. W. 博蒙特先生昨日否认曾担任该公司经理。他指出，直到查封当日才在美国领事馆注册公司，这一疏忽引发了所有麻烦。

博蒙特先生在采访中承认，这种违规行为可能是因为艺术工作室的官员忽略了收到地方法院的通知，即法院已就孔兴电线厂（Kong Shing Electric Wiring Works）对他们作出的约2,800美元的缺席判决。该判决于1933年12月6日作出。

然而，公司发布的声明写道：“据 J. Marc 先生称，艺术工作室坚决否认这一索赔……”

China Press, April 21, 1934.

Studio D'Art
Is Sealed On
Court Order

Creditor Forces Action
Against Firm Under
Beaumont Management

Delaware Concern Said
Not American Registered

The offices and stores of Studio
D'Art (Inc.) furnishings and decora-
tors, 128 Bubbling Well Road,
were sealed by an order
issued by the First Special
District Court yesterday, up-
on the request of one of the cre-
ditors of the company. It was gen-
erally believed that the concern
was registered at the American
Consulate, but upon investigation it
was revealed that such was not the
case and action accordingly was
taken by Messrs. Jones, Shidei
Electro-Plating Works, against the
company in the District Court.

The Studio D'Art has been for
the past year or more been man-
aged by A. W. Beaumont, editor of
the Shanghai Spectator, and the de-
feated "Shanghai News" candi-
date for the Municipal Council.

It was understood yesterday that
counsel for the Studio D'Art had ar-
gued that as the concern failed
to file any petition for bankruptcy
in the Court, there was no reason
for it to be liquidated as a bankrupt com-
pany.

Mr. Beaumont is an American, but
American authorities have stated
that the firm is not registered with
them. The company was incorporated
in Delaware, U.S.A., and the pro-
ceedings were taken against it in
the company's name. It is under-
stood that Mr. Beaumont has left
Shanghai.

An official of the American Con-
sulate stated that Studio D'Art was
not registered at the American
Consulate, although possibly being
incorporated in Delaware. The
official pointed out that not being
registered at the consulate the com-
pany was not entitled to protection
from the United States authorities.

It was revealed yesterday that the
Chinese firm who had applied for a
court order to seal the furniture
firm, had obtained judgment against
it in the First Special District Court
about six months ago for about
$2,800. No payment against the
judgment was made and an order
to seal was granted by the court
some time ago but was not enforced
until yesterday.

The first public indication that
Studio D'Art was financially em-
barrassed was given last Wednesday
when a group of coolies and work-
men at Studio D'Art on Bubbling
Well Road, where the workshops
are also situated, created a minor
riot, demanding their overdue pay.

The furniture store was first
started by two Frenchmen in 1924
or 1925 on Avenue Joffre and ran
on a small scale. In 1926 or 1927,
Mr. F. Tchong, Chinese returned
art and interior decorating student
from France, bought it over and
named it Studio D'Art and gra-
dually developed, widening the
business.

Mr. Tchong agreed to have Mr.
Beaumont organize the C.M. for him
on a salary basis in 1931, in order
to be able to expand.

《字林西报》，1934年4月21日。

艺术工作室
依法院命令
被封

债权人在博蒙特管理下
迫使对公司采取行动

称特拉华州企业
未在美注册

应公司一位债权人的请求，第一特区地方法院昨日发布命令，查封了位于南京路128号的艺术工作室（股份有限公司）家具与装饰公司的办公室和商店。人们普遍认为该公司已在美国领事馆注册，但调查显示并非如此，因此琼斯先生、志日电镀厂（Jones, Shidei Electro-Plating Works）在地方法院对该公司采取了行动。

过去一年或更长时间里，艺术工作室一直由《上海观察家报》编辑、市议会竞选失败的“上海新闻”候选人 A. W. 博蒙特管理。

据悉，艺术工作室的律师昨日辩称，由于该公司未向法院提交任何破产申请，没有理由将其作为破产公司进行清算。

博蒙特先生是美国人，但美国当局表示该公司未在他们那里注册。该公司在美国特拉华州注册成立，诉讼是以公司名义进行的。据悉博蒙特先生已离开上海。

美国领事馆一名官员表示，艺术工作室未在美国领事馆注册，尽管可能在特拉华州注册。该官员指出，由于未在领事馆注册，该公司无权获得美国当局的保护。

昨日披露，申请法院命令查封该家具公司的中国公司，约六个月前在第一特区地方法院获得了对该公司的约2,800美元的判决。判决后未支付款项，法院此前已颁发查封令，但直到昨日才执行。

上周三首次公开显示艺术工作室陷入财务困境，当时位于南京路的艺术工作室（车间也设在此处）的一群苦力和工人发生小规模骚乱，要求支付拖欠的工资。

这家家具店最初由两名法国人于1924或1925年在霞飞路创办，规模较小。1926或1927年，从法国归国的中国艺术与室内装饰学生 F. 忠（F. Tchong）先生买下该店，命名为艺术工作室（Studio D'Art），并逐步发展，扩大业务。

为了能够扩张，忠先生于1931年同意由博蒙特先生以薪金制为基础为他组建管理委员会（C.M.）。

A.W. Beaumont alias Israelovitch who vacated, or

Embassy Hotel, Bubbling Well Road. The agreement
for his new apartment he signed on April 30 and entered

Sir,
I beg to report that in the course of further enquiries made
with a view to obtaining information regarding the disputed
ownership of the Studio D'Art between the former owner Mr. Tsong
Hung and the present shareholders, Mr. Beaumont alias Israelovitch,
Mr. Jerome Marcs and Major Strubel, the following proceedings
were taken.

D.S.I. Moir interviewed Mr. C.D. Meinhardt, Land office of the
U.S.A. Consulate and ascertained that Jerome Marcs was registered
as an American Citizen.

The Studio D'Art although incorporated in Delaware, U.S.A.
had not been registered with the U.S.A. Consulate in Shanghai,
but that an application for registration of the above firm had
been received, but not yet approved. Mr. Meinhardt explained
that before the approval of the application he would like to
speak to Mr. Tsong Hung personally. Therefore in the forenoon
of the 2-5-34, D.S. Gigarson located Mr. Tsong and asked him to
come to the U.S.A. Consulate, where Mr. Meinhardt and Mr. Tsong
had a conversation lasting about two hours. When Mr. Tsong left
the U.S.A. Consulate, he stated that Mr. Meinhardt promised to
give any information wanted concerning the case to his lawyer
Mr. Paul Fremet and Mr. Tsong proceeded then to see this lawyer
immediately. On the 4-5-34, at the Belgian Court was the second
hearing of the case against Mr. Beaumont, the proceedings of this
hearing were published in all Shanghai Newspapers. The case was
remanded to the 11-5-34, on which date neither Mr. Beaumont nor
his lawyer d'Auxion de Ruffe, R. appeared, but objected in
writing the jurisdiction over the case in the Belgian Consular
Court. The case was remanded for judgment to the 14-5-34 P.M.

Sir,
I beg to report that at about 5 p.m. 18-4-34, I was on
duty on Bubbling Well Road in the vicinity of the Foreign Y.
M. C. A. attending to the Ranking of motor cars for the Rate-
Payers Meeting at the Carlton Theatre, when I observed a
Foreigner being held by a well dressed male Chinese and
surrounded by about 20 other Chinese people, at that moment
the Foreigner broke away from the Chinese and attempted to
run, therefore I crossed the roadway and stopped him, the first
thought entering my mind that he was a Foreign Pickpocket, as
he could not have been termed as being well dressed. The
Chinese kept stating "He has my money", and on being questioned
as to the trouble the Foreigner would not reply, until further
questioning of the Chinese, whereupon about twenty of them all
stated he owed them money for work that they completed for him,
at the "Studio D'Art".

The Foreigner then gave his name as Mr. Beaumont and stated
he had to attend the ratepayers meeting, therefore I told him
to go, he then entered the premises of the "Studio D'Art". I
advised the crowd of Chinese people to refrain from causing
trouble on the roadway, and if they had any complaint to make
against Mr. Beaumont to do so at Sinza Police Station, as they
could not fight in the roadway over debts; these people then
dispersed.

Some time later I was called to the "Studio D'Art" as these
Chinese People had returned and were threatening to make trouble,
I entered the premises accompanied by P.S.148 Aston, and found
about twenty Chinese people upstairs, who stated they would not

该外国人随后报出姓名为 Beaumont 先生，并称他必须参加纳税人会议，因此我让他离开，他随即进入了“艺术工作室”的场所。我建议这群中国人不要在马路上制造麻烦，如果他们对 Beaumont 先生有任何投诉，应前往新闸捕房提出，因为他们不能因债务问题在马路上斗殴；这些人随后散去。

With reference to the report of D.S. Wittinsky (Boarding House Section) dated January 22, 1934, on the subject of the "Pro-Shanghai Group", I have to state that the campaign of this group started with a view to interesting the local Russian community in the so called "Civic Reform Movement" began about the middle of November 1933, when article entitled "Russians, awake!" appeared in the "Shanghai Spectator", of which W.A. Beaumont is the editor. Apart from critical remarks on the present system of the municipal administration in the Settlement the article contained an appeal to the local "White-Russian" ratepayers to overcome the "inferiority complex they are suffering from", to unify and organise themselves before the coming municipal elections in order to secure in the Council a seat for their representative, who would defend the interests of the Russian community and assist them in the acquiring of civil rights in the Settlement equal to the rights of foreigners of other nationalities.

The appearance, on January 14, 1934, of the Russian edition of the "Shanghai Spectator" was another phase of the campaign launched by Beaumont. On this occasion the editor's address to the Russian public reads as follows :-

"In beginning the publication of the Russian edition of the 'Shanghai Spectator' our object is to assist, as far as we can, in bringing about the unification of Russian residents in Shanghai in order that they might acquire rights equal to the rights of other foreign residents of this city, and have their own representative in the Council, their own municipal schools, charitable institutions etc.

    《上海扎里亚报》（Shanghai Zaria）指出，国际租界的地位正按照费瑟姆法官（Justice Feetham）报告中所指出的方向发生变化，这已成为当务之急；同时，该报警告当地俄国居民不要采取任何无组织的行动，以免成为敌视俄国移民势力的牺牲品。
    另一份当地俄文报纸《斯洛沃报》（Slovo）在1934年1月14日的社论中，毫不掩饰地怀疑“一些神秘的外国人试图‘拯救’俄国移民的奇怪举动”，并指出“正当后者在没有此类外国朋友协助的情况下，面对远东即将发生的事件表现出强烈的团结倾向之时，这些事件对俄国移民的重要性是任何地方事务都无法比拟的”。
    博蒙特（Beaumont）或许能在俄国居民中招募到个别支持者，但可以肯定的是，他得不到负责任的俄国界别的支持；这些界别普遍视其为声誉可疑之人，并且对他未经授权代表当地俄国社群进行干预深感不满。
    关于据称由“亲上海小组”（Pro-Shanghai Group）发出并在租界俄国居民中分发的传单，据我方情报，其目的是找出那些有权参加市政选举但未被列入享有此权利的正式纳税人名单的人员。

Subject (in full) Pro - Shanghai Group, 15 Museum Road.

Made by D.S. Wittinsky Forwarded by Supt. Quayle

Sir,
The undersigned begs to report, that at 10a.m. 20-1-34
whilst calling at 4 Astor Terrace, Astor Rd, Lodging House owned
by Mrs E.Babekashvily, Russian, he was informed by her, that at
about 3p.m. 19-1-34 a male Russian visited her house and presented
the attached slip, which he requested her to fill in. Mrs E.Babekas
hvily on asking him who he was and what the slip was for, was told
that the particulars contained in the slip were required by the
Shanghai Municipal Council.
Being suspicious of the Russian, Mrs E.Babekashvily refused
to comply with the request. The visitor then gave her several slips
asking to fill in one of them and stating that he would call again
departed, without divulging his name.
At 9.30a.m. 22-1-34 the undersigned paid a visit to 15 Mu-
seum Rd, where on the ground floor the sign of the "Shanghai Spec-
tator" was observed. On entering the office situated on the 3d floor
the undersigned was approached by a Russian woman, to whom the slip
was shown and particulars asked as to the Pro - Shanghai Group.
It was elicited, that the slips were being distributed to
all shops and houses with a view to obtaining information required
by Mr.A.W.Beaumont in his work of organizing a Pro - Shanghai Group
which will "defend the interests of the Russian Shanghai residents."
For further information re above, it was suggested to the
undersigned to have a personal interview with Mr.A.W.Beaumont.

（批：Q.C. (sp Bn)）
（批：Please add any information）
（批：at once to C.P.）
（批：A. Beaumont）
（印：D.C. (CRIME) 22 JAN 1934）

I am, Sir,
your obedient servant

先生，
    卑职谨此报告，1934年1月20日上午10时，卑职走访位于阿斯特路（Astor Rd）阿斯特台4号（4 Astor Terrace）、由俄国人E. 巴贝卡什维利夫人（Mrs E. Babekashvily）拥有的寄宿房屋时，她告知卑职，1934年1月19日下午3时许，一名俄国男子到访其住所，并出示了附上的传单，要求她填写。当E. 巴贝卡什维利夫人询问此人身份及传单用途时，对方称传单所载资料系工部局所需。
    E. 巴贝卡什维利夫人对该俄国男子心生疑窦，拒绝配合其要求。该访客随后留给她几张传单，要求她填写其中一张，并称会再次来访，随后未透露姓名便离去。
    1934年1月22日上午9时30分，卑职前往博物馆路15号，在一楼观察到“上海观察家报”（Shanghai Spectator）的招牌。进入位于三楼的办公室后，一名俄国妇女走近卑职，卑职向其出示了传单，并询问有关亲上海小组的情况。
    经探询得知，这些传单正分发给所有商店和住户，旨在获取A.W. 博蒙特先生（Mr. A.W. Beaumont）在组织一个将“捍卫上海俄国居民利益”的亲上海小组的工作中所需要的资料。
    关于上述事项的进一步信息，建议卑职与A.W. 博蒙特先生进行个人面谈。

（批：Q.C. (sp Bn)）
（批：请立即补充任何信息）
（批：即刻呈交警务处长。）
（批：A. 博蒙特）
（印：刑事侦缉处 1934年1月22日）

先生，
